baseRomFiles.name: BitmapPatch
baseRomFiles.text:
?BANK 02

?INCLUDE 'scene_script'

-- Patch for bitmap loading which adds support for no compression

!LSAMPLE	       $10
!LOOPNUM	       $12
!SPTR		         $3E
!DPTR		         $5E
!TPTR1		       $72
!TPTR2		       $75
!DCMP_SIZE	     $78


--------------------------------------------
;Main bitmap handler

loc_028503! {
    LDA [$3E]
    INC $3E
    INC $3E
    STA $78
    CMP #$0001
    BMI CheckInterleavedFlag
    CPX #$066C
    BNE loc_028520
    LDA $06EE
    BIT #$0800
    BEQ loc_028520
    JMP $&DeinterleavePlanarTiles
}
    
CheckInterleavedFlag! {
    CPX #$066C
    BNE DmaTileStripToVram
    LDA $06EE
    BIT #$0800
    BEQ DmaTileStripToVram
    JMP $&code_0285F3
}

-------------------------------------------
;First pass, copy palette information into VRAM from tileset


code_0285F3! {
    PHY				-- Y will be our read offset
    PHB				-- data bank will be changed

    LDA SPTR			-- init offset for temp pointers
    STA TPTR1
    CLC
    ADC #$0010
    STA TPTR2

    SEP #$20	

    LDA SPTR+2		-- init bank for temp pointers
    STA TPTR1+2
    STA TPTR2+2

    LDA #$7E			-- set data bank to $7E
    PHA
    PLB
    STZ $0E			-- ??
    LDY #$A000		-- init DPTR with WRAM offset
    STY DPTR
    JSR BuildAttributeTable	-- this call changes SPTR to reference WRAM tileset palette data
    LDY #$0000		-- init read offset to 0. using Y because of long addressing. setting here because previous call clobbers it

  --No change here
  loc_028608!:
    LDA #$07			-- init sample counter
    STA LOOPNUM

    LDA (SPTR)		-- read lookup sample and increment pointer
    STA LSAMPLE
    INC SPTR
    BNE loc_028616
    INC SPTR+1
    
  loc_028616!:
    LDA [TPTR1], Y
    STA $00
    LDA [TPTR2], Y
    STA $04
    INY
    LDA [TPTR1], Y
    STA $02
    LDA [TPTR2], Y
    STA $06
    INY

    LDX #$0007		-- init rotate counter

  --No change
  loc_02862D!:
    LDA #$00
    ROL $06
    ROL
    ROL $04
    ROL
    ROL $02
    ROL
    ROL $00
    ROL
    ORA LSAMPLE

    STA (DPTR)		-- store result and increment pointer
    INC DPTR
    BNE loc_028645
    INC DPTR+1

  loc_028645!:
    DEX
    BPL loc_02862D	-- continue rotate (8 times)

    DEC LOOPNUM
    BPL loc_028616	-- continue sample (8 times)

    REP #$20			-- increment read counter by $10
    TYA
    CLC
    ADC #$0010
    TAY
    SEP #$20

    CPY #$2000
    BCC loc_028608	-- continue read ($2000 bytes)

    ;Not sure if this is necessary
    STZ $0671		-- clear 'last loaded' banks so next resource loads
    STZ $067D
    STZ $0680
    STZ $0683

    PLB 

    LDX #$0000
    STX $VMADDL
    LDA #$80
    STA $VMAIN
    LDA #$00
    STA $DMAP0
    LDA #$19
    STA $BBAD0
    LDX #$A000
    STX $A1T0L
    LDA #$7E
    STA $A1B0
    LDX #$4000
    STX $DAS0L
    LDA #$01
    STA $MDMAEN
    PLY 
    PLP 
    RTS 
}

--------------------------------------------------

Load4bppPage! {
    LDA [$3E]
    STA $78
    INC $3E
    INC $3E
    CMP #$0001
    BMI loc_0285B2
    LDX #$7000
    STX $7A
    JSL $@QuintetLzDecompress
    LDX #$7000
    STX $3E
    LDA #$007E
    STA $40
}

baseRomFiles.name: Cop51Patch
baseRomFiles.text:
?BANK 00

?INCLUDE 'cop_handlers_collision'

!SPTR		$3E
!DCMP_SIZE	$78

--------------------------------------------

Decompress!:
  PHY 
  PHD 
  LDA [$0A]
  INC $0A
  INC $0A
  STA $003E
  LDA [$0A]
  INC $0A
  AND #$00FF
  SEP #$20
  STA $0040
  REP #$20
  LDA [$0A]
  INC $0A
  INC $0A
  STA $007A
  LDA [$0A]
  INC $0A
  AND #$00FF
  LDA #$0000
  TCD

cop51_main:
  LDA [SPTR]
  BMI cop51_minus
  BEQ cop51_zero
  STA DCMP_SIZE
  INC SPTR
  INC SPTR
  JSL $@QuintetLzDecompress
  JSL $@ClearActorRenderList
  BRA cop51_end

cop51_zero:
  LDA #$2000
  BRA cop51_domvn

cop51_minus:
  LDA #$0000
  SEC
  SBC [SPTR]

cop51_domvn:
  INC SPTR
  INC SPTR

  SEC
  SBC #$0001
  PHA

  SEP #$20
  LDA #$7E
  STA $0404
  LDA SPTR+2
  STA $0405
  REP #$20

  LDX SPTR
  LDY $7A

  PLA
  JSR $0402

cop51_end:
  PLD 
  PLY 
  TYX
  LDA $0A
  STA $02, S
  RTI

    ;BRK #$70
    PHX
    LDA #$0000
    STZ $00DA
    SEP #$20

    LDY #$0010

    DEY
    BMI generate_number_quit
    LDA $inventory_slots, Y
    CMP #$01
    BEQ generate_number_jewels
    CMP #$06
    BEQ generate_number_herbs
    CMP #$0E

    BRA generate_number_top

    LDA $crystal_count

    PHA

    ASL

    TAX
    LDA @SlotPositionTable, X

    ADC #$num_xoffset
    STA $25

    ADC #$num_yoffset

    LDA $25

  inv_remove_stub:
    SEP #$20
    LDA $inventory_slots, X

    BEQ inv_remove_jewel
    CMP #$06
    BEQ inv_remove_herb
    CMP #$0E

    STA $jewels_collected

    LDA #$1000

;Entry point for adding an item to the inventory

GiveItemToPlayer! {
    PHP 
    SEP #$20

  inv_give_item_handler:
    CMP #$01
    BEQ inv_give_jewel
    CMP #$06
    BEQ inv_give_herb

    LDA #01

    INC $crystal_count
    LDA #0E

?BANK 03

  #FF #02 #02 #02 #02 #05 #05 #02 #02 #02 #02 #02 #02 #04 #FF #FF  ;9F
  #06 #06 #06 #06 #06 #06 #06 #06 #06 #06 $FF #FF #04 #FF #FF #FF  ;AF
  #04 #0B #0B #0B #0B #0B #0B #0B #0B #0B #0B #0B #0B #0B #0B #04  ;BF
  #11 #FF #FF #02 #02 #04 #02 #02 #02 #02 #FF #FF #04 #04 #0C #0C  ;CF
  #0C #0C #0C #0C #0C #0C #0C #0C #0C #0C #0C #0C #02 #0F #04 #04  ;DF
  #04 #04 #04 #04 #0E #0E #16 #FF #FF #06 #FF #FF #FF #FF #FF #FF  ;EF

bgm_track_map [
  #00 #06 #06 #07 #05 #09 #0A #0C #0F #10 #0B #08 #11 #06 #13 #12
  #14 #0D #02 #15 #16 #0E #04 #00 #18 #17 #19 #00 #03 #00 #1A #01

bgm_loop_map [
  #00 #00 #01 #01 #01 #01 #01 #01 #01 #01 #01 #01 #01 #00 #01 #01
  #01 #01 #01 #01 #00 #01 #01 #00 #00 #00 #00 #00 #01 #01 #00 #01
]


---------------------------------------
;Function that queues a music fade on a specific frame (from A)

count_check {
    PHA
    LDA token
    BEQ count_ret
    BMI no_msu_fade

    ;LDA $0D72
    ;BNE no_msu_fade

    ;LDA msu_flag
    ;BEQ no_msu_fade
    
    LDA $01, S
    DEC
    BEQ msu_reset

    ASL
    ASL
    ASL
    ASL
    ORA #0F
    STA $2006
    BRA count_ret

  msu_reset:
    STZ $2006
    STZ $2007
    STZ token
    BRA count_ret
    
  no_msu_fade:
    LDA $01, S
    CMP #06
    BNE count_ret

    LDA #F2
    STA $APUIO0
    STZ token

  count_ret:
    PLA
    RTS
}

---------------------------------------

WriteApuIo0! {
    SEP #$20
    LDA msu_flag
    BEQ cop0A_normal           ;Normal process when no MSU

    LDA $0D72
    CMP #$1B
    BNE cop0A_normal           ;Normal process when current track is not 1B
    
    LDA [$0A]
    ;INC $0A
    ;AND #$00FF
    CMP #$7F
    BEQ cop0A_msu_pause        ;Stop playback on 7F
    
    LDX $06F2
    LDA @bgm_loop_map, X
    BEQ $04

    LDA #$03
    BRA $02

    LDA #$01

    STA $2007                   ;Start playback on other commands (only 01)
    BRA cop0A_exit

  cop0A_msu_pause:
    STZ $2007
    BRA cop0A_exit

  cop0A_normal:
    LDA [$0A]
    STA $APUIO0

  cop0A_exit:
    REP #$20
    TYX
    LDA $0A
    INC
    STA $02, S
    RTI 
}

--------------------------------------
;Hook for SPC init

    REP #$20

    LDA $2002
    CMP #$2D53
    BNE msu_unavailable
    LDA $2004
    CMP #$534D
    BNE msu_unavailable
    LDA $2006
    CMP #$3155
    BNE msu_unavailable
    
    SEP #$20
    LDA #01
    STA msu_flag
    BRA init_complete

  msu_unavailable:

  init_complete:
    LDX #$&spc_sound_engine
    STX $46
    LDA #$^spc_sound_engine
    STA $48
    JSR $&SpcIplHandshake
    RTL 
}

--------------------------------------
;Hook for checking track changes before screen transition

ExecuteSceneTransition! {
    LDA $0654
    BMI loc_03DA03
    BEQ loc_03DA00
    
  ;do_check:
    PHX
    PHY
    STZ token
    LDA $0D72           ;Is music playing?
    BEQ change_return          ;Should only be on boot
    LDA $0D5A
    BNE change_accept          ;Scenario where map movement is staged before transition
    LDX meta_next_id
    BEQ change_accept
    LDA @bgm_table, X
    BMI change_return          ;This is important
    TAY
    LDX meta_current_id
    LDA @bgm_table, X
    BMI change_return
    TYA
    CMP @bgm_table, X
    BEQ change_return

  change_accept:
    LDA $0D72
    CMP #1B
    BNE do_f2

    LDA msu_flag
    BEQ change_return

    LDA #6B             ;Flag an MSU fade with a positive value (any value works)
    BRA $02

  do_f2:
    LDA #F2
    STA token          ;Store value #F2 in token to flag a music fade
  
  change_return:
    PLY
    PLX
    JSR $&ScreenExitTransition
}

-----------------------------------------------

loc_03DADC! {
    JSL $@UpdateFrameDialogue
    LDA $0DB6
    BEQ loc_03DAF1
    DEX 
    BPL loc_03DADC
    STA $INIDISP

----------------------------------------------

-------------------------------------------
;Mosaic mode 

loc_03DB05! {
    JSL $@UpdateFrameDialogue

    STA $INIDISP
    PHA 
    EOR #$0F
    ASL 
    ASL 
    ASL 
    ASL 
    ORA #$03

    PLA

    JSR count_check
    DEC

}

--------------------------------------------

loc_03DB6F! {
    LDA $006E

    PHA 
    JSL $@ResetHdmaState
    LDA #$FF
    STA $6C

    JSR $&ApplyScrollWaveEffect
    INC 
    STA $006E
    LDA $02, S
    DEC 
    STA $02, S
    BNE loc_03DB6F
    LDA $01, S
    
    JSR count_check
    DEC 
    STA $01, S
    STA $INIDISP
    BNE loc_03DB6A
    LDA #$00
    STA $INIDISP
    PLA 
    PLA 
    STZ $0070
    STZ $006E
    RTS 
}

-------------------------------------------------

loc_03DBBC! {
    INC $006E
    STA $00
    PHA 
    JSL $@ResetHdmaState
    LDA #$FF
    STA $6C
    PLA 
    JSR $&ApplyScrollWaveEffect
    JSL $@UpdateFrameDialogue
    LDA $01, S
    DEC 
    STA $01, S
    BNE loc_03DBBC
    LDA $064A
    STA $01, S
    LDA $02, S

    JSR count_check
    DEC 
    STA $02, S
    STA $INIDISP
    BNE loc_03DBBC
    LDA #$00
    STA $INIDISP
    PLA 
    PLA 
    STZ $0070
    STZ $006E
    RTS 
}

---------------------------------------------
;Hook for fading music via COP 05

SpcCheckMusicReady! {
    SEP #$20
    LDA msu_flag
    BEQ cop_fade_normal     ;Assume normal process when no MSU
    
    REP #$20
    LDA #$00FF
    STA $24
    COP [C1]
    LDA $24
    BEQ SpcTransferMusicData
    DEC
    SEP #$20
    STA $2006
    REP #$20
    STA $24
    RTL

  cop_fade_normal:
    LDA #$F1
    STA $APUIO0
    REP #$20
    COP [C2]
    LDA $APUIO0
    AND #$00FF
    CMP #$00F1
    BEQ loc_03E1C1
    RTL 
}


loc_03E1C1! {
    SEP #$20
    LDA #$01
    STA $APUIO0
    REP #$20
    COP [C2]
    SEP #$20
    LDA $APUIO0

---------------------------------------------
;Hook for stopping music via COP 04/05

SpcTransferMusicData! {
    SEP #$20
    LDA msu_flag
    BEQ bgm_load_wait   ;Always skip APU silent since we are always branching to the standard load process

    ;LDA $0D72
    ;CMP #$1B
    ;BNE bgm_load_wait   ;Normal process when current track is not 1B
    
    LDA #$00
    STA $2007
    BRA bgm_load_wait     ;Stop playback, then trigger music load

  ;cop_stop_normal:
    ;LDA #$F0
    ;STA $APUIO0
    ;REP #$20
    ;COP [C2]
    ;SEP #$20
    ;LDA $APUIO0
    ;REP #$20
    ;BEQ loc_03E1EB
    ;RTL

loc_03E1EB! {
    ;COP [C2]
    ;SEP #$20
    ;LDA #$FF

  bgm_load_wait:
    REP #$20
    LDA $7F000A, X
    STA $06FA
    COP [C2]
    LDA $06FA
    CMP #$FFFF

}

loc_03E208! {
    COP [DA] ( #01 )
    ;SEP #$20
    ;LDA #$01
    ;STA $APUIO0
    ;REP #$20
    COP [C2]
    STZ $06F8
    STZ $06FA
    COP [E0]
}

---------------------------------------------

LoadMusicFromTransitionState! {
    LDX $06FA
    BEQ loc_03E254
    BMI loc_03E254

  ;immed_load_normal:
    REP #$20
    TXA 
    ASL 
    CLC 
    ADC $06FA
    TAX 
    
    ;LDA msu_flag
    ;AND #$00FF
    ;BEQ immed_load_continue
    
    LDA $@music_pointer_array-3, X
    STA $3E
    STA $0687
    LDA $@music_pointer_array-2, X
    STA $3F
    STA $0688

    LDA $06FA
    STA $06F2
    PEA &bgm_load_exit-1
    SEP #$20
    JML @loc_028B91

  ;immed_load_continue:
    ;LDA $@music_pointer_array-3, X
    ;STA $46
    ;STA $0687
    ;LDA $@music_pointer_array-2, X
    ;STA $47
    ;STA $0688
    ;JSL $@func_028191
    ;JSL $@SpcBlockTransfer
    ;JSL $@func_0281A2
    
    ;LDA $06FA
    ;STA $06F2
    ;SEP #$20
    ;STA $0D72
    ;LDA #$01
    ;STA $APUIO0
    ;REP #$20
    
    ;LDA #$FFFF
    ;STA $06FA
}

}

---------------------------------------------
;Hook for music asset loading (from scene_meta)

SpcMusicLoadCmd! {
    JSR $&ReadScriptByte
    PHA
    JSR $&ReadScriptByte
    STA $06F4
    LDX #$003E
    JSR $&LoadScriptPointer
    LDA $06F6
    CMP $06F4
    BEQ loc_028B88
    PLA
    RTS 
}

loc_028B88! {
    PLA
    STA $06F2
    LDX #$0687
    JSR $&CheckSourceCacheHit
    BCS loc_028B91
    RTS 
}

loc_028B91! {
    LDA $06F2
    BEQ bgm_check               ;Always branch to halt when reset is loading

    LDA msu_flag
    BNE msu_begin_load

  bgm_check:
    LDA $06F2
    CMP $0D72
    BNE $01
    RTS                         ;Check against current track, if no change then quit

    STA $0D72

  bgm_halt:
    LDA #$01
    JSL $@WaitFrames
    LDA #$F0
    STA $APUIO0
    LDA #$03
    JSL $@WaitFrames           ;For some reason this is required
    LDA #$FF
    STA $APUIO0
    LDA #$02
    JSL $@WaitFrames
    
  bgm_init:
    LDA $0D72
    CMP #1B
    BEQ bgm_load_empty

    LDX $3E
    STX $46
    LDX $40
    STX $48
    ;LDA $06F2
    ;STA $0D72

  bgm_load:
    ;LDX $46
    ;STX $0687
    ;LDX $47
    ;STX $0688
    JSL $@SpcBlockTransfer
    LDA #$03
    JSL $@WaitFrames
    LDA $06F2
    BEQ $02
    LDA #$01
    STA $APUIO0
    RTS

  bgm_load_empty:
    LDX #&bgm_no_music
    STX $46
    LDX #*bgm_no_music
    STX $48
    ;LDA #$1B
    ;STA $0D72
    BRA bgm_load

  msu_begin_load:
    LDX $06F2                   
    CPX #$001B
    BNE msu_begin_continue      ;If 1B is not requested, continue

    STZ $2007                   ;Stop playback when 1B is requested

    LDA $0D72
    CMP #$1B
    BNE $01
    RTS                         ;Exit if 1B is already playing

    LDA #$1B
    STA $0D72
    BRA bgm_halt                ;Set loading track to 1B and begin halt

  msu_begin_continue:
    LDA @bgm_track_map, X
    STZ $2006
    STA $2004
    STZ $2005

  msu_busy_wait:
    BIT $2000 
    BVS msu_busy_wait           ;Wait for data busy to clear

    LDA $2000
    AND #08
    BEQ msu_start_playback
    LDA $06F2
    STA $0D72
    JMP bgm_halt                ;Track not found, revert to normal process

  msu_start_playback:

    LDA @bgm_loop_map, X
    BEQ msu_start
    LDA #$03
    BRA msu_write

  msu_start:
    LDA #01

  msu_write:
    STA $2007                   ;Start playback
    LDA #FF                     ;Max volume
    STA $2006
    LDA $0D72
    CMP #$1B
    BEQ msu_return

    LDA #1B
    STA $0D72
    JMP bgm_halt

  msu_return:
    RTS

}

bgm_load_exit {
    REP #$20
    LDA #$FFFF
    STA $06FA
    SEP #$20
    RTL
}

projectFiles.text:
;CHAPTER 1

----------------------
?INCLUDE 'pr8C_prologue1'
----------------------
spritestring_0BD044! ~The world was in[N]the midst of the[N]Age of Discovery.~
spritestring_0BD06D! ~People set foot on[N]new continents,[N]unearthing the[N]legacy of ancient[N]civilizations.~

----------------------
?INCLUDE 'pr8D_prologue2'
----------------------
spritestring_0BD0B2! ~The passage of[N]time gave birth[N]to many legends.~
spritestring_0BD0E3! ~There were as many[N]ruins as legends,[N]and as many[N]legends as ancient[N]civilizations.~
spritestring_0BD11C! ~Various artifacts[N]were found in[N]the ruins.~
spritestring_0BD144! ~Among them, with[N]few exceptions,[N]were strange[N]statues modeled[N]after gods.~
spritestring_0BD189! ~What were gods[N]to the ancients?[N]The ruins stand[N]silent, their[N]lips sealed.~

----------------------
?INCLUDE 'pr8E_prologue3'
----------------------
spritestring_0BD1CA! ~People captivated[N]by the allure of[N]lost ages ventured[N]into the ruins and[N]into their doom.~

----------------------
?INCLUDE 'pr8F_prologue4'
----------------------
spritestring_0BD222! ~Some people spoke[N]of traps placed to[N]protect treasure.[N][N]Others called[N]it a curse[N]from the[N]ancients.~

----------------------
?INCLUDE 'pr8C_prologue5'
----------------------
spritestring_0BD272! ~Yet not a single[N]soul realized that[N]these events were[N]connected to [N]the tremendous[N]disaster about[N]to unfold.~

----------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc08_priest'
----------------------
dialogstring_048AE9! `[TPL:0][TPL:8][DLY:0]My name is [NAM:0].[FIN][TPL:B]Today marks exactly one[N]year since I joined my[N]dad on an expedition[N]to the Tower of Babel.[FIN]When dad's team met with[N]disaster, only I was able[N]to safely return to this[N]town…[FIN]Even now, I can't believe[N]that dad died or anything[N]like that. No, I refuse to[N]believe it…[FIN][CLD][TPL:0][TPL:A][DLY:0]When I grow up, I'm going[N]to become an explorer, and[N]travel around the world.[FIN]If that happens, I have[N]a hunch that somewhere,[N]I'll be able to find dad…[END]
dialogstring_048C01! `[TPL:16][TPL:D]Priest: Let's go ahead and[N]end today's lesson here.[FIN][TPL:E]Going forward, I'd like[N]the four of you to do your[N]best not to fall behind.[FIN][TPL:F]Furthermore, demons have[N]been sighted outside of[N]town. If you must go far,[N]please bring a parent.[END]`
dialogstring_048C98! `[TPL:16][TPL:D]Priest: Come now, [NAM:0].[N]Please pray with me.[FIN][TPL:E]Oh God. May the world[N]continue to shine on for[N]all eternity…[END]`

----------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc08_erik'
----------------------
dialogstring_048DD1! `[TPL:5][TPL:9][NAM:5]: Alright, so the[N]usual place today![END]`
dialogstring_048E00! `[TPL:3][TPL:9][NAM:3]: I'll be there, but I[N]need to hurry home first…[FIN][TPL:B]If I don't, mama will find[N]out that I had to stay for[N]make-up lessons again.[N]Heheh…[END]`

----------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc08_lance'
----------------------
dialogstring_048D3A! `[TPL:4][TPL:A][NAM:4]: Alright! Then same[N]as always, we'll meet at[N]the cave by the seashore![END]`

----------------------
?INCLUDE 'sE6_gaia'
----------------------
dialogstring_08DD0B! `[TPL:17][TPL:E][DLY:0]I am Gaia, fountainhead of[N]life. Henceforth, I shall[N]offer aid in thy journey.[FIN][TPL:F]Only those in whom the[N]Power of Darkness dwells[N]can see this space.[N]Thou art such a human.[FIN]Here in the Dark Space,[N]thou canst make record of[N]thy adventure. Pray drop[N]by during thy travels.[FIN]`
dialogstring_08DDCB! `[TPL:17][TPL:F]What sayest thou? Record[N]thy adventure thus far?[N][PAL:0] Record[N] Don't record`
dialogstring_08DE43! `[CLD][PAU:27][TPL:17][TPL:D]Thou shouldst now continue[N]forth upon thy journey.[END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc01_roof_man'
------------------------
dialogstring_0484B7! `[TPL:16][TPL:E]Come on, [NAM:0]. How many[N]times do I have to tell[N]you not to come up here?[FIN]You've got this habit of[N]jumping down from all[N]sorts of places… (sigh)[FIN][CLD][TPL:16][TPL:D]I can't help worrying[N]about you.[END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc01_sprint_man'
------------------------
dialogstring_04923D! `[TPL:16][TPL:E]You seem like you've got[N]pretty fast feet, huh?[N]Have you tried sprinting?[FIN][TPL:F]Quickly tap the direction[N]button twice, or hold the[N]sprint button while[N]moving. Give it a shot![END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'jeweler_gem'
------------------------
dialogstring_08D094! `[TPL:16][TPL:D]I am Gem, a jeweler who[N]travels the seven seas.[FIN]`
dialogstring_08D0C8! `[TPL:16][TPL:E]Right now, the number of[N]red jewels I'm holding for[N]you is [PAL:0][BCD:2,AB0][PAL:4].[FIN]`
dialogstring_08D0F1! `[TPL:16][TPL:F]Good day to you.[N]What is it that you want?[N][PAL:0] Just wanted to see you.[N] Deposit red jewels.[N] Show me your goods.`
dialogstring_08D139! `[CLD][TPL:16][TPL:D]Is that so? Well then,[N]good day to you.[FIN][TPL:E]Incidentally, if you lift[N]a red jewel, it will fly[N]to my location, you know.[FIN]Now let me be frank with[N]you. I'm a master of[N]disguise, believe you me.[FIN]Even were you to see me in[N]another town, you might[N]not recognize me.[END]
dialogstring_08D1E0! `[CLD][TPL:16][TPL:E]Ah, but you don't have any[N]jewels. I suppose it's the[N]thought that counts![END]`
dialogstring_08D20F! `[CLD][TPL:16][TPL:E]Hmmm… This is a truly[N]excellent jewel, don't[N]you agree?[FIN]I'm going to look after[N]it with the utmost care,[N]I assure you![FIN]With this, the total[N]number of jewels should[N]be [PAL:0][BCD:2,AB0][PAL:4] altogether.[FIN]`
dialogstring_08D267! `[CLD][TPL:16][TPL:E]When you collect enough[N]jewels, I'll give you the[N]goods on this list.[END]`
dialogstring_08D2D0! `[CLD][TPL:16][TPL:E]Well hey, looks like[N]you've surpassed [PAL:0]3[PAL:4] jewels,[N]haven't you![FIN][CLD][TPL:16][TPL:D]According to the list, you[N]get a Medicinal Herb.[FIN]`
dialogstring_08D31A! `[CLD][TPL:16][TPL:D]Received a Medicinal Herb[N]from the jewel merchant![FIN]`
;dialogstring_08D332! `[CLR][LU1:67]collected [LU1:BE][N]five [LU1:23]According to[N]the list, [LU1:FE]Defense [N][LU2:25][LU1:EF]be raised. [FIN][LU1:68]Defense [LU2:25]is[N][LU1:C5]by one.[FIN]`
;dialogstring_08D395! `[CLR][LU1:67]collected over, [N]eight [LU1:23]According to[N]the list, [LU1:FE]Life [N][LU2:25][LU1:EF]be raised. [FIN][LU1:68]Strength is[N][LU1:C5]by one.[FIN]`
;dialogstring_08D3F9! `[CLR][LU1:67]collected [LU1:BE][N]12 [LU1:23]According to [N]the list, [LU1:FE]Strength [N][LU1:EF]be raised. [FIN][LU1:68]Attack [LU2:25]is[N][LU1:C5]by one.[FIN]`
;dialogstring_08D459! `[CLR][LU1:67]collected [LU1:BE][N]20 [LU1:23]According to [N]the list, [LU1:FE][LU1:3C][N][LU2:25][LU1:EF]be raised. [FIN][LU1:1D]a mysterious power[N]given by the spirit.[FIN][LU1:68][LU1:3C]Dash Power[N]is increased.[FIN]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc01_guard'
------------------------
dialogstring_0485B6! `[TPL:16][TPL:E]Hey, hey! Monsters have[N]been prowling outside of[N]town recently, you know.[FIN][TPL:F]Did the priest in the[N]church not warn you? You[N]shouldn't thoughtlessly[N]go outside the town.[END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc01_astronomer'
------------------------
dialogstring_0488FB! `[TPL:16][TPL:D]An astronomer I know told[N]me something strange.[FIN][TPL:E]There's a star heading for[N]Earth, or something to[N]that effect.[END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc01_worried_woman'
------------------------
dialogstring_04871E! `[TPL:16][TPL:F]I'm getting worried about[N]all of these strange[N]merchants we've been[N]seeing around here lately.[FIN]I think they're taking[N]advantage of people's[N]concern over the recent[N]appearance of monsters.[END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc01_house_intro'
------------------------
dialogstring_04BD1B! `[TPL:0][TPL:F]This is my house. There's[N]a nice smell wafting by.[N]Grandma [NAM:6] must be[N]baking one of her pies.[END]`
dialogstring_04BD5F! `[TPL:0][TPL:F]This is my best friend[N][NAM:4]'s house. He and his[N]frail mother live here,[N]just the two of them.[END]`
dialogstring_04BD9B! `[TPL:0][TPL:D]Here's where my friend[N][NAM:3] lives.[FIN][TPL:F]This house is the biggest[N]in South Cape. I admit I[N]feel a bit jealous of[N]people born into money…[END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc01_salesman'
------------------------
dialogstring_0482D7! `[TPL:16][TPL:F]Salesman: I go around to[N]everyone's houses selling[N]weapons, so they can fight[N]those monsters.[FIN]It's a dangerous world out[N]there these days. Still, I[N]can't justify selling a[N]weapon to a kid like you.[END]`
dialogstring_04835C! `[TPL:16][TPL:C]Salesman: Hmmm…[END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc01_girl3'
------------------------
dialogstring_0481D6! `[TPL:16][TPL:D]How long have we been[N]playing this game?[END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc01_girl2'
------------------------
dialogstring_04816B! `[TPL:16][TPL:E]It's mysterious. Why's[N]this one called "The[N][NAM:F]…?"[END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc01_girl1'
------------------------
dialogstring_0480FF! `[TPL:16][DLG:5,8][SIZ:8,1][DLY:2]10… 9… 8… 7… 6…[END]`
dialogstring_048112! `[TPL:16][DLG:7,8][SIZ:8,1][DLY:1]5… 4… 3… 2… 1![END]`
dialogstring_048125! `[TPL:16][DLG:4,8][SIZ:B,1]Tsk, it's always me…[END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc01_startled_woman'
------------------------
dialogstring_0487F5! `[TPL:16][TPL:F]I envy the way the sea[N]breeze blows your hair[N]around. Not like mine,[N]under this scarf…[END]`
dialogstring_0487BF! `[TPL:16][BOR:2][DLG:10,8][SIZ:3,1]Eek![FIN][CLD][::][TPL:16][TPL:D]What are you doing? This[N]kid! Good grief…[END]`
dialogstring_0487F1! `[JMP:&dialogstring_0487BF+M]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc01_sympathetic_woman'
------------------------
dialogstring_04899E! `[TPL:16][TPL:D]I can't help but pity[N]poor [NAM:5].[FIN][TPL:F]It's messed up for someone[N]so young to see his[N]parents fighting day in[N]and day out, you know?[END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc01_fisherman'
------------------------
dialogstring_04840F! `[TPL:16][TPL:E]Even in a different spot,[N]I still can't catch[N]anything at all…[END]`
dialogstring_0483F6! `[TPL:16][TPL:D]Tch. Not catching[N]anything at all…[END]`
dialogstring_048436! `[TPL:16][TPL:D]I accidentally fished up[N]this weird pot.[END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc01_jar_door'
------------------------
dialogstring_048A48! `[TPL:0][TPL:E]As soon as the door to[N][NAM:5]'s house was opened,[N]a pot came flying out![END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc03_lances_mother'
------------------------
dialogstring_048F19! `[TPL:16][TPL:D][NAM:4]'s Mother: It's been[N]a whole year, hasn't it?[FIN][TPL:E]Since your father and my[N]husband went missing at[N]the Tower of Babel?[FIN][CLD][TPL:16][TPL:D]Somehow, it still feels[N]like it was yesterday…[END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc04_poverty'
------------------------
dialogstring_048F9D! `[TPL:16][TPL:E]The most trifling stuff in[N]the world can determine[N]if you're rich or poor.[FIN][TPL:F]Ahhh, if only money grew[N]on trees… I wonder if[N]there's a good opportunity[N]lying around somewhere.[END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc04_eriks_father'
------------------------
dialogstring_048FEF! `[TPL:16][TPL:E][NAM:3]'s Father: Everyone[N]acts jealous of this big[N]house…[FIN][TPL:F]But it's not a big deal.[N]We simply moved to this[N]town a little earlier than[N]everyone else.[END]

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc04_eriks_mother'
------------------------
dialogstring_04907B! `[TPL:16][TPL:F][NAM:3]'s Mother: No, my back[N]isn't on fire. Hahaha.[N]This is an eastern therapy[N]called "moxibustion."[FIN][CLD][TPL:16][TPL:E]With a big house, even[N]just cleaning is bound[N]to cause shoulder pain…[END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc05_seths_father'
------------------------
dialogstring_049193! `[TPL:16][TPL:8][NAM:5]'s Father: Hmph.[FIN][TPL:B]I bust my hump for that[N]money, so what's wrong[N]with spending some of it[N]on a little booze?![END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc05_seths_mother'
------------------------
dialogstring_049110! `[TPL:16][TPL:9][NAM:5]'s Mother: It's no[N]joke! That man![FIN][TPL:B]I put up with it for[N][NAM:5]'s sake, but if it[N]weren't for him, I'd have[N]left a long time ago![END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc06_lola'
------------------------
dialogstring_0499F1! `[TPL:3][TPL:B][NAM:6]: Oh, [NAM:0]! Welcome[N]home. Dinner's not quite[N]ready, so you still have[N]time to go play outside.[END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc06_bill'
------------------------
dialogstring_04941D! `[TPL:4][TPL:B]Bill: Ohh, welcome home.[N]Getting back at this hour[N]must mean you were kept[N]behind again, huh?[FIN][CLD][TPL:4][TPL:9]Bwahaha.[N]Splendid, splendid.[FIN][TPL:B]Even if a boy can't study,[N]being lively and spirited[N]is a better quality, I[N]always say.[END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc07_chef'
------------------------
dialogstring_0491ED! `[TPL:16][TPL:B]Mmm, that's a nice smell.[N]My house doesn't have a[N]stove, so I do my cooking[N]in a pot, like this.[END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'hidden_red_jewel'
------------------------
dialogstring_00C6A6! `[TPL:C][SFX:10]You found a Red Jewel![END]`

;CHAPTER 2

----------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc02_entry'
----------------------------
dialogstring_04BE87! `[TPL:0][TPL:A]It wouldn't be wrong to[N]call this seaside cave our[N]second home.[FIN][TPL:B]Usually, we meet here[N]after our lessons at[N]church are finished and[N]chat until the sun sets.[END]`

dialogstring_04BF35! `[TPL:4][TPL:9][NAM:4]: What the heck,[N][NAM:0]? Going home already?[FIN][TPL:A]Dinner time's still a ways[N]off, so let's stick around[N]and have fun a bit longer.[END]`

----------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc02_lance'
----------------------------
dialogstring_04B1CB! `[TPL:4][TPL:9][NAM:4]: What gives, [NAM:0]?[N]You're pretty late, man.[FIN][TPL:B]Right now, I'm in the[N]middle of a match of[N]Blackjack with [NAM:5].[N]Wait a sec.[END]`

----------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc02_seth'
----------------------------
dialogstring_04B5B6! `[TPL:5][TPL:9][NAM:5]: Ahaha! I'm sure to[N]win again.[END]`

----------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc02_erik'
----------------------------
dialogstring_04B9AF! `[TPL:0][TPL:A][DLY:0]Suddenly, [NAM:3] came flying[N]in with an urgent look[N]on his face![WAI][CLD]`

dialogstring_04B9F2! `[TPL:3][BOR:2][TPL:9][NAM:3]: (huff huff)[N]News! It's BIG news![FIN][TPL:A]Edward Castle's princess[N]has gone missing! They say[N]she came to this town![END]`

dialogstring_04BA55! `[TPL:4][TPL:B][NAM:4]: Dude, so what? With[N]you barging in here like[N]that, I thought something[N]much cooler had happened.[FIN]Besides, that "princess"[N]is just that selfish girl[N][NAM:1], yeah? Who cares[N]about someone like that?[END][TPL:3][TPL:A][NAM:3]: That's true, but[N]soldiers will come around[N]here looking for her.[FIN][TPL:B]The soldiers from Edward[N]Castle just look so cool,[N]don't they? I really want[N]to see them.[END]`

dialogstring_04B210! `[TPL:4][TPL:A][NAM:4]: Don't just stand[N]there, [NAM:0]. Go sit next[N]to [NAM:3].[END]`

dialogstring_04B612! `[TPL:5][TPL:A][NAM:5]: I'm not really[N]interested in girls.[N]Reading books is more fun.[END]`

dialogstring_04BB59! `[TPL:3][TPL:A][NAM:3]: Dang, I thought[N]everyone was gonna be so[N]amazed…[END]`

dialogstring_04B652! `[TPL:5][TPL:A][NAM:5]: Alright, since[N]everyone's here, what's[N]the plan for today?[FIN][CLD][PAU:1E][TPL:3][TPL:9][NAM:3]: Hey, I wanna see[N][NAM:0]'s mysterious power.[FIN][TPL:B]Come on, didn't you show[N]us the other day? You can[N]move things without using[N]your hands.[END][TPL:4][TPL:A][NAM:4]: If I'm remembering[N]right, he moved the stone[N]statue in the cave's nook.[FIN][CLD][TPL:4][TPL:9]Show us one more time,[N][NAM:0].[END]`

dialogstring_04BB89! `[TPL:3][TPL:A][NAM:3]: You moved the statue[N]without going near it the[N]other day, right?[END]`

dialogstring_04B23F! `[TPL:4][TPL:B][NAM:4]: If I recall, when[N]you spun your flute like a[N]baton, the statue was[N]pulled to you, yeah?[END]`

dialogstring_04B72B! `[TPL:5][TPL:A][NAM:5]: Face toward the[N]stone statue and press[N]the L or R button.[END]`

dialogstring_04B75D! `[TPL:4][TPL:8][NAM:4]: Aah! It moooooved![PAU:28][END]`

dialogstring_04B27E! `[TPL:4][TPL:9][NAM:4]: Alright. This time,[N]let's try the card trick.[FIN][TPL:B]I'll put four cards face[N]down. Pick the one you[N]think is the Ace of[N]Diamonds.[FIN][CLD]`

dialogstring_04B2F0! `[TPL:4][TPL:A][NAM:4]: Go on. Choose the[N]one you think is the Ace[N]of Diamonds.[END]`

dialogstring_04BBB6! `[TPL:3][TPL:9][NAM:3]: If only I could do[N]that too…[END]`

dialogstring_04B77C! `[TPL:5][TPL:A][NAM:5]: No matter how many[N]times I see it, it's still[N]amazing.[FIN]But why can you move the[N]statue when you can't move[N]anything else…?[END]`

----------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc02_card'
----------------------------
dialogstring_04B00F! `[TPL:16][BOR:0][TPL:8][NAM:0] picks up a card.[WAI][N][TPL:A]Beyond the shadow of a[N]doubt, it was the Ace of[N]Diamonds![END]`

dialogstring_04B328! `[PAU:1E][TPL:4][BOR:2][TPL:9][NAM:4]: Ahh. Right on the[N]money![END]`

dialogstring_04BC16! `[TPL:3][TPL:9][NAM:3]: Phew. I'm[N]speechless…[FIN][CLD][TPL:3][TPL:8]Hey, [NAM:5].[FIN][TPL:A]This sort of thing is[N]called extrasensory[N]perception, right?[END]`

dialogstring_04B7DE! `[TPL:5][TPL:A][NAM:5]: The meaning of[N]"extrasensory perception"[N]is…[FIN]just as the word says: the[N]ability to perceive things[N]beyond normal human sense.[FIN][TPL:B]We usually identify the[N]traditional five human[N]senses as sight, hearing,[N]taste, smell, and touch.[FIN][CLD][TPL:5][TPL:A]I'm thinking that[N]extrasensory perception[N]might be the sixth sense.[END]`

dialogstring_04B344! `[PAU:1E][TPL:4][TPL:A][NAM:4]: I don't understand[N]the stuff Professor [NAM:5][N]says all that well.[END]`

dialogstring_04B386! `[TPL:4][TPL:A][NAM:4]: Come on, [NAM:5].[N]While the cards are out,[N]let's play another game.[END]`

dialogstring_04B3AD! `[TPL:4][TPL:9][NAM:4]: One more game with[N][NAM:5] and I'm going home.[END]`

projectFiles.text:
;CHAPTER 3

----------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc01_house_intro'
----------------------------
dialogstring_04BE05! `[TPL:0][TPL:E]Upon leaving the cave,[N]twilight had completely[N]painted the area.[END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc06_hamlet'
------------------------
dialogstring_04A311! `[TPL:0][TPL:A]There's a pig wrecking the[N]room![FIN]But why is there a pig in[N]my house…?[END]`
dialogstring_04A356! `[BOR:2][TPL:8](oink oink)[END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc06_kara'
------------------------
dialogstring_049EB4! `[TPL:1][TPL:A][NAM:1]: Oh my, [NAM:7]. You[N]shouldn't bully people you[N]don't know.[FIN][CLD][TPL:1][TPL:9]Do you belong to this[N]household?[FIN][CLD][PAU:0F][TPL:0][TPL:8][NAM:0]: Uh-huh. So what?[END]`

dialogstring_049F09! `[TPL:1][TPL:9][NAM:1]: Your clothes are a [N]bit drab, aren't they?[FIN][CLD][PAU:0F][TPL:0][TPL:8][NAM:0]: Well, excuse me![FIN][CLD][PAU:0F][TPL:1][TPL:A][NAM:1]: And your father?[N]Your mother? Are they not[N]around?[END]`

dialogstring_049F71! `[TPL:1][TPL:D][NAM:1]: Are they the two in[N]this picture?[FIN][CLD][PAU:0F][TPL:0][TPL:D][NAM:0]: That's right. My dad[N]went on an expedition and…[END]`

dialogstring_049FBC! `[TPL:1][TPL:B][NAM:1]: I know. It was the[N][NAM:9] expedition party,[N]and there was an accident,[N]right?[FIN][CLD][PAU:0F][TPL:0][TPL:9][NAM:0]: He's definitely[N]coming home someday.[FIN][CLD][PAU:0F][TPL:1][TPL:9][NAM:1]: Are you angry…?[N]No, that's not it.[FIN][TPL:A]I've made you sad,[N]haven't I? How stupid[N]of me… I'm sorry…[END]`

dialogstring_04A04C! `[TPL:1][TPL:9][NAM:1]: Anyway, is there[N]not a piano in this house?[FIN][CLD][PAU:0F][TPL:0][TPL:A][NAM:0]: No, I'm afraid not.[N]My Grandma [NAM:6] is an[N]incredible singer, though.[FIN][CLD][PAU:0F][::][TPL:1][TPL:B][NAM:1]: Speaking of[N]singing, both of your[N]grandparents are upstairs,[N]doing just that.[FIN][CLD][TPL:1][TPL:9]They have such loud[N]voices![END]`
dialogstring_04A0D2! `[JMP:&dialogstring_04A04C+M]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc06_lola'
------------------------
dialogstring_049ABB! `[TPL:3][TPL:A][NAM:6]: Welcome home, [NAM:0].[N]Silly me. I lose track of[N]time when singing opera.[FIN][CLD][TPL:3][TPL:8]Dinner isn't ready yet.[END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc06_bill'
------------------------
dialogstring_0494B1! `[TPL:4][TPL:A]Bill: Good gracious. It's[N]been a while since I sang[N]so loudly.[FIN]Long ago, your Grandma[N][NAM:6] was a songstress in[N]a bar, you know.[FIN]I fell in love with her[N]beautiful voice and heart,[N]so I proposed. Bwahahaha.[END]`

dialogstring_049A3F! `[TPL:3][TPL:A][NAM:6]: Ohohohoo! Stop it,[N]dear! Bringing up a thing[N]like that right now…[FIN][CLD][PAU:0F][TPL:3][TPL:9]Oh yes! [NAM:0], try not to[N]be too surprised.[FIN][TPL:A]Until just a moment ago,[N]there was a girl here[N]singing with us, you know…[END]`

dialogstring_04953E! `[TPL:1][BOR:2][TPL:8][DLY:0]No-o-o-o-o!!![FIN][CLD][TPL:9][SFX:10][DLY:0]A shriek resounded from[N]the first floor![END]`

dialogstring_04956D! `[TPL:4][TPL:9]Bill: That sounds like her[N]screaming right now![END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc06_main_soldier'
------------------------
dialogstring_04A3BB! `[TPL:19][TPL:9]Soldier: Your Highness.[N]We were looking for you![FIN][CLD][PAU:0F][TPL:1][BOR:2][TPL:A][NAM:1]: I don't know who[N]any of you people are.[N]Get out of here![FIN][CLD][PAU:0F][TPL:19][TPL:B][SFX:10]Soldier: What are you[N]saying? If I don't bring[N]you you back home, my[N]head's going to roll.[END]`

dialogstring_04A0D7! `[TPL:7][BOR:3][TPL:B][NAM:1]: I think you have[N]the wrong person. You see,[N]I'm a flower girl called[N]Popongo.[FIN][CLD][PAU:0F][TPL:19][TPL:A]Soldier: Your Highness![N]Do you think I can be[N]fooled with such a…[FIN][CLD][TPL:7][BOR:7][SEP:1,77FD][SEP:2,564F][SEP:3,1000][SEP:13,1000][TPL:8]…red-faced lie…?![FIN][TPL:19][TPL:B]This is a direct order[N]from the king. Even if we[N]have to use brute force,[N]we're taking you home![END]`


dialogstring_04A15A! `[TPL:1][TPL:B][NAM:1]: I'm sorry for[N]lying to you. I'm really[N][NAM:1], the princess of[N]Edward Castle.[FIN][CLD][TPL:1][TPL:A]You said your name is[N][NAM:0]? It doesn't feel like[N]the first time we've met.[FIN][CLD][TPL:1][TPL:9]It somehow seems like[N]we'll be good friends.[END]`

dialogstring_04958A! `[TPL:4][TPL:9]Bill: There goes a real[N]prankster. Bwahaha.[END]`

dialogstring_049B18! `[TPL:3][TPL:A][NAM:6]: Speaking of Edward[N]Castle, a vast aqueduct[N]lies beneath it, you know.[FIN][TPL:A]And let me tell you[N]something: the person who[N]designed that labyrinth?[FIN][CLD][TPL:3][TPL:9]That would be your[N]grandfather, here.[FIN][CLD][PAU:0F][TPL:0][BOR:2][TPL:8][NAM:0]: Huh? Really?[END][CLD]`

dialogstring_0495C9! `[PAU:0F][TPL:4][TPL:9]Bill: Long ago, I used to[N]be an architect.[END]`

dialogstring_0495EB! `[TPL:4][TPL:9]There's a prison built[N]beneath the castle.[FIN][TPL:A]It was designed to be a[N]complex maze, so prisoners[N]couldn't escape easily.[FIN][TPL:B]Every day, though, I feel[N]guilt over all the people[N]still being sent to the[N]jail that I made…[END]`

dialogstring_049B82! `[PAU:40][::][TPL:3][TPL:A][NAM:6]: Okay, that's enough[N]depressing talk. Dinner's[N]about ready. Let's eat.[FIN][TPL:B]I baked a delicious pie.[N]Please come along now,[N]both of you. We'll sit[N]at the table upstairs.[END]`

dialogstring_049685! `[TPL:4][TPL:B]Bill: Hey [NAM:0]. Don't you[N]think your Grandma [NAM:6]'s[N]cooking has been a bit odd[N]lately?[FIN]Last night[NAM:17][N]rice. Before that, it was[N][NAM:18]. I can't[N]stand eating like this…[FIN]People say that when you[N]get old and there are[N]problems you can't fix,[N]you start going senile…[FIN][CLD][TPL:4][TPL:A]But maybe she's anxious[N]and troubled by something[N]she can't tell us about…[END]`

dialogstring_04A4CC! `[TPL:0][DLG:3,B][SIZ:D,4]In the end, dinner was a[N][NAM:19] pie that was[N]absolutely loaded with[N]whipped cream…[FIN]I could only stomach a[N]small piece, but Grandpa[N]Bill powered through and[N]ate three slices.[FIN][CLD][TPL:0][DLG:3,B][SIZ:D,3]That night, I dreamt that[N][NAM:1] and I were traveling[N]around the world together…[END]`

------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc06_monologue'
------------------------
dialogstring_04A582! `[TPL:0][TPL:E]And the next morning,[N]something terrible was[N]about to unfold…[END]`

dialogstring_049828! `[TPL:4][TPL:B]Bill: Good morning. I had[N]to eat more of Grandma[N][NAM:6]'s pie for breakfast…[N](heavy sigh)[END]`

dialogstring_049BE5! `[TPL:3][TPL:A][NAM:6]: Good morning, [NAM:0].[N]A letter from King Edward[N]has come for you.[FIN][CLD][TPL:9]This is what was written[N]in the letter…[FIN][CLD][PAU:0F][TPL:4][BOR:7][DLG:3,D][SIZ:D,6]"Please bring the crystal[N] ring that was found in[N] [NAM:9]'s belongings to[N] Edward Castle."[N][N]             -King Edward[FIN][CLD][PAU:0F][TPL:3][TPL:A][NAM:6]: From the momoent I[N]saw this letter, I've had[N]a temper stirring.[FIN][TPL:B]Ah, that's it! [NAM:0], let[N]me teach you this melody.[N]It's a kind of charm for[N]good luck.[FIN]Whenever you find yourself[N]in a bind, if you play[N]this melody, I'm sure[N]you'll make it through.[FIN][CLD][PAU:0F][TPL:9][NAM:6] hummed a mysterious[N]melody.[END]`

dialogstring_04D069! `[TPL:1][TPL:9][NAM:1]: Alright. We're[N]finally heading out, huh?[FIN][TPL:B]First, let's try to go to[N]your house. You must be[N]worried about Mrs. [NAM:6][N]and Mr. Bill.[FIN][CLD][TPL:9]The two hurried to [NAM:0]'s[N]house.[END]`

?INCLUDE 'sc06_kara_return'
--------------------------------
dialogstring_04AF7F! `[TPL:0][TPL:A][NAM:0]: (No, there must[N]definitely be a clue in[N]the house...)[END]`

dialogstring_04A746! `[TPL:0][TPL:A][NAM:0]: Wah…! What in the…[N]Why does it look like[N]this…[END]`

dialogstring_04A766! `[TPL:1][TPL:A][NAM:1]: This is awful…![N]Who could have done[N]something like this…[FIN][TPL:0][TPL:A][NAM:0]: What about Grandma[N]and Grandpa!?[END]`

dialogstring_04A7E1! `[TPL:1][TPL:F][NAM:1]: Eeeeeeek…!![N]Come here! Help! [NAM:0]![N]It's, it's a disaster,[N]a disaster![END]`

dialogstring_04A81F! `[TPL:0][TPL:C][NAM:0]: What happened!?[FIN][TPL:1][TPL:C][NAM:1]: Look at this wall![FIN][TPL:D]This emblem, the mark of a[N]leopard with black fur…[FIN]That means [NAM:16][N]came here![FIN][TPL:0][TPL:D][NAM:0]: "[NAM:16]ˮ…?[FIN][TPL:1][TPL:D][NAM:1]: The assassin that[N]my mother hired recently![FIN]He's a tenacious, morbid,[N]sinister man.[FIN][TPL:E]If he has someone in his[N]sights once, it's already[N]over… [FIN]He's a man that with no[N]concern whatsoever about[N]things like human life![FIN][TPL:0][TPL:E][NAM:0]: Then,[WAI][N]Grandpa and Grandma…[END]`

--------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc06_lily'
--------------------------------
dialogstring_04AC0C! `[TPL:2][TPL:D][NAM:2]: You don't have to[N]worry, you two.[FIN][TPL:0][TPL:D][NAM:0]: Ah. It's you, from a[N]while ago…[END]`

dialogstring_04A945! `[TPL:1][TPL:C][NAM:1]: Who are youuu!?[FIN][TPL:2][TPL:C][NAM:2]: I'm [NAM:0]'s friend.[FIN][TPL:0][TPL:D][NAM:0]: [NAM:2], do you know[N]something?[FIN][TPL:2][TPL:E][NAM:2]: It's okay. Grandpa[N]Bill and Grandma [NAM:6] are[N]safe too.[FIN]They're hiding in my[N]village.[FIN][TPL:1][TPL:E][NAM:1]: Your village?[END]`

dialogstring_04AC45! `[TPL:2][TPL:D][NAM:2]: The village of the[N]Itory clan.[FIN][TPL:1][TPL:E][NAM:1]: I haven't even[N]heard of a village like[N]that![END]`

dialogstring_04AC77! `[TPL:2][TPL:C][NAM:2]: Naturally![FIN][TPL:F]There's a barrier put up[N]in my village so that[N]normal humans can't see[N]it, you know…?[FIN][CLD][TPL:2][TPL:C]Alright, let's go, [NAM:0]![FIN][TPL:0][TPL:C][NAM:0]: Sure![FIN][TPL:1][TPL:D][NAM:1]: I'm coming along[N]too![FIN][TPL:2][TPL:D][NAM:2]: Your Majesty would[N]be in danger…[FIN][TPL:1][TPL:F][NAM:1]: I'm definitely[N]coming along with you![N]That way, I can truly[N]become free…!![FIN][TPL:2][TPL:F][NAM:2]: That's just how it[N]is, little lady.[END]`

dialogstring_04A9D7! `[TPL:1][TPL:E]I feel like some lovely[N]experiences are awaiting[N]us.[END]`

dialogstring_04AD69! `[TPL:2][TPL:F][NAM:2]: Are you going to[N]go and meet with everyone[N]before going to my[N]village?[FIN]It might be a while[N]before we can come back.[END]`

dialogstring_04ADCA! `[TPL:2][TPL:D][NAM:2]: Huh…? Are you[N]done already?[FIN][TPL:E]Or are you going to check[N]on the state of the town[N]for a bit?[END]`

?INCLUDE 'sc08_priest'
--------------------------------
dialogstring_048CDB! `[TPL:16][TPL:E]What's the matter, [NAM:0]?[N]You're looking at people's[N]faces so closely…[FIN]You're probably scheming[N]something again, huh…?[END]`

?INCLUDE 'jeweler_gem'
--------------------------------
dialogstring_08D332! `[CLR]Whoops, the number of[N]jewels you've collected[N]have passed 5, haven't[N]they…![FIN]Going by the list, I'll[N]give you Protection Force.[FIN]With that, your defensive[N]power should rise by one.[FIN]`

--------------------------------
dialogstring_04B5ED! `[TPL:5][TPL:C]Ugh, it's always me…[END]`

--------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sc02_lance'
--------------------------------
dialogstring_04B40D! `[TPL:4][TPL:9][NAM:4]: What's tha matter,[N][NAM:0]? Ya got a sad face.[FIN][TPL:A]Ya havin' some problems[N]that ya can't tell us[N]about?[END]`

?INCLUDE 'sc02_erik'
--------------------------------
dialogstring_04BBDA! `[TPL:3][TPL:9][NAM:3]: What's wrong? You're[N]different than usual.[END]`

dialogstring_04ADFE! `[TPL:2][TPL:B][NAM:2]: Have you decided[N]to head out?[N][PAL:0] Yes[N] No[PAL:4]`

dialogstring_04AE24! `[CLR][NAM:2]: Is that so. Well,[N]some back here when you're[N]in the mind to set out.[END]`

dialogstring_04AE61! `[TPL:1][TPL:B][NAM:1]: I feel like some[N]lovely experiences are[N]ahead of us.[FIN][TPL:2][TPL:B][NAM:2]: No, from here,[N]there will definitely be a[N]lot of difficulties…[N]*Sigh*…[END]`

dialogstring_04A9F8! `[TPL:1][TPL:A][NAM:1]: But we'll stand[N]against them one by one,[N]right?[END]`

dialogstring_04AA20! `[TPL:1][TPL:9][NAM:1]: Ah, you're my[N]friend, right?![FIN][TPL:A][PAL:0] Yeah, of course[N] I can't so easily know[N] you that well…`

dialogstring_04AA7D! `[CLD][TPL:1][TPL:A][NAM:1]: I'm glad, [NAM:0]. Come[N]on, let's hold hands as we[N]go.[FIN][JMP:&dialogstring_04AAAD+M]`

dialogstring_04AAAD! `[CLD][TPL:2][TPL:A][NAM:2]:[N]I'm going with you.[N]Let's go.[FIN][::][CLD][TPL:A]Like this, the three[N]headed to [NAM:2]'s[N]village.[END]`

;CHAPTER 7


---------------------------------

---------------------------------
dialogstring_04E3D5! `[TPL:2][TPL:D][NAM:2]: This is my[N]village.[FIN][TPL:F]Even though I said it,[N]you're still surprised[N]that there are no houses,[N]right?[FIN][NAM:0], try playing that[N]melody from before when I[N]called out to you in[N]Edward's Castle basement.[END]`
dialogstring_04E440! `[TPL:2][TPL:E][NAM:2]: [NAM:0]. Where are you[N]going? Play the melody[N]here…[END]`

---------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'chunk_038000'
---------------------------------
dialogstring_038CA0! `[CLD][TPL:E]The melody rode on the[N]wind and was spread[N]throughout the prairie.[END]`

dialogstring_04E46F! `[TPL:2][TPL:D][NAM:2]: Did it surprise[N]you?[FIN][TPL:E]Normally people can't see[N]our Itory village because[N]it has a barrier.[FIN]Anyway, the little lady[N]was suffering, wasn't[N]she…?[FIN][TPL:10]On the mountain road, I[N]felt like I was going[N]crazy with hearing "my[N]feet are hurtingˮ and[N]"I'm thirstyˮ.[END]`

---------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'it15_kara'
---------------------------------
dialogstring_04E124! `[TPL:1][TPL:E][NAM:1]: I can't help that.[N]After all, my feet really[N]were hurting.[FIN][TPL:2][TPL:F][NAM:2]: Well, I think[N]that's okay. Anyway,[N]please come with me. I'll[N]guide you to my house.[END]`

---------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'it16_song_woman'
---------------------------------
dialogstring_04DF96! `[TPL:18][TPL:F]The Incans that once lived[N]on this land were a people[N]without a written[N]language.[FIN]Their legends were passed[N]down through sound.[FIN]They say that there are[N]intentional meanings even[N]in melodies that are sung[N]thoughtlessly.[END]`

---------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'it15_friendly_woman'
---------------------------------
dialogstring_04E033! `[TPL:18][TPL:E]There aren't any children[N]around [NAM:2]'s age in[N]this village.[FIN]Please be good friends[N]with her, alright?[END]`

---------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'it15_lola'
---------------------------------
dialogstring_04F11E! `[TPL:3][TPL:D][NAM:6]: [NAM:0]! [NAM:0]![N]This way![FIN][TPL:4][TPL:D]Bill: So you were safe;[N]good, good…[FIN][TPL:3][TPL:D][NAM:6]: We saw some very[N]frightening sights![FIN][TPL:E]A man called [NAM:16][N]came taking a large crowd[N]of soldiers with him…[FIN][TPL:4][TPL:E]Bill: We were almost[N]killed![END]`

dialogstring_04F1BA! `[TPL:3][TPL:C][NAM:6]: Bill, oh my…[FIN][TPL:E]I upset the soldiers'[N]stomachs with my poison[N]apple pie.[FIN]We barely escaped in that[N]moment.[END]`

dialogstring_04F210! `[TPL:3][TPL:F][NAM:6]: Oh, that's right.[N][NAM:2], thank you for your[N]work. Come inside with[N]Princess [NAM:1].[END]`

dialogstring_04E53C! `[TPL:2][TPL:D][NAM:2]: Well then, follow[N]me if you'd like.[FIN][TPL:10][NAM:0]. This house is mine.[N]But if you want to[N]sightsee around the[N]village before you come[N]back, that's okay.[END]`

dialogstring_04E175! `[TPL:1][TPL:D][NAM:1]: Wait, [NAM:2].[N]I'll go too.[END]`

---------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'it18_warning_man'
---------------------------------
dialogstring_04DDC7! `[TPL:18][TPL:A]Many people come to this[N]land in search of Incan[N]gold.[FIN][TPL:B]However, I guess that[N]those who trespass into[N]Incan ruins haven't[N]returned…[END]`

---------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'it18_warning_woman'
---------------------------------
dialogstring_04DE81! `[TPL:18][TPL:A]The ruins the grave of an[N]ancient people. Shouldn't[N]we leave it alone…?[END]`

---------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'it15_fable_man'
---------------------------------
dialogstring_04DEC9! `[TPL:18][TPL:F]It's said around here that[N]when the world of old was[N]falling into ruin, a[N]saviour appeared.[END]`

---------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'it15_fable_woman'
---------------------------------
dialogstring_04DF22! `[TPL:18][DLG:3,D][SIZ:D,6]Back then, things like the[N]spread of mysterious[N]illnesses without known[N]causes or disappearances[N]seemed to be increasing in[N]towns around the world…[FIN][CLD][TPL:18][TPL:D]I hope that there is peace[N]on this planet forever.[END]`

---------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'sE6_gaia'
---------------------------------
dialogstring_08DF80! `[PRT:@dialogstring_08DE96]Thy power, Psycho Dash,[N]can destroy such things as[N]walls and obstacles.[FIN]Try it on suspicious[N]places thou have noticed[N]which thou cannot destroy.[FIN]`

dialogstring_08EB68! `[TPL:E][DLY:5]Became able to use the[N]Power of Darkness,[N][ADR:&table_08EB8F,AAC]![PAU:50][FIN]`
dialogstring_08EB85! `[TPL:17][TPL:F][DLY:2][ADR:&table_08EBD3,AAC][END]`

dialogstring_08EBDF! `The Psycho Dash is a power[N]that only [NAM:0], the young[N]boy, can use.[FIN]With a body check attack[N]thou canst easily crush[N]things like obstacles and[N]destructible walls.[FIN]Thou shouldst charge up[N]using the attack button…`

---------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'it15_running_man'
---------------------------------
dialogstring_04DE32! `[TPL:18][TPL:E]Try running down that hill[N]over there. You'll[N]definitely be surprised.[END]`

---------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'it17_kara'
---------------------------------
dialogstring_04E1F6! `[TPL:1][TPL:B][NAM:1]: It's a charming[N]village, right? The wind[N]feels nice and[N]refreshing…[END]`

---------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'it17_lily'
---------------------------------
dialogstring_04E62C! `[TPL:2][TPL:9][NAM:2]: The Elder is in[N]the flower field.[FIN][TPL:A]I don't know how old he[N]is, but he's a very[N]knowledgeable person.[FIN]Do you want to try and[N]meet him?[END]`

dialogstring_04F249! `[TPL:3][TPL:D][NAM:6]: Somehow I had an[N]unpleasant hunch.[END]`

---------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'it15_bill'
---------------------------------
dialogstring_04EFAE! `[TPL:4][TPL:F]Bill: Go on, you should[N]meet with the Elder. He[N]definitely knows[N]something, after all.[END]`

------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'it19_inca_statue_a'
------------------------------
dialogstring_04F38D! `[TPL:D][SFX:0][DLY:9]You've found[N]Incan Statue A.[PAU:A0][CLD]`

dialogstring_04F3A8! `[TPL:E]You've found Incan [N]Statue A! But your [N]inventory is full! [END]`

---------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'it15_elder'
---------------------------------
dialogstring_04E9FF! `[TPL:D][NAM:0] could hear a feeble[N]voice from behind him…[FIN][TPL:4][BOR:6][TPL:D]Mysterious voice: It was[N]good that you came, [NAM:0]…[END]`

dialogstring_04EA45! `[TPL:4][BOR:6][TPL:D]Elder: Here, I'm over[N]here. I'm in the flowers.[FIN]I've extended my life[N]too long.[END]`

dialogstring_04EA77! `[TPL:4][BOR:6][TPL:10]Elder: If the flower[N]fairies aren't giving me[N]their protection like[N]this, I won't be able to[N]survive.[FIN][CLD][TPL:4][BOR:6][TPL:E]While we're talking, you[N]look so much like your[N]parents.[FIN]It seems like yesterday[N]that your father came to[N]our village.[FIN][CLD][TPL:0][TPL:C][NAM:0]: My dad came to your…[FIN][TPL:4][BOR:6][TPL:D]Elder: Your mother…[N]Putting in briefly.[FIN][TPL:F][NAM:8], your grandparents[N]Bill and [NAM:6]'s daughter,[N]was an extremely beautiful[N]woman.[FIN]Your father fell in love[N]at first sight and stole[N]her from this village.[FIN]Everyone in the Itory clan[N]holds a mysterious power,[N]but [NAM:8]'s was grander[N]than any other.[FIN]She even erected the[N]barrier that renders this[N]village invisible from the[N]outside.[FIN]But your father came[N]inside very easily.[FIN]When I think about it,[N]that man was also a[N]mysterious human being…[FIN]`

dialogstring_04EC46! `[TPL:4][BOR:6][TPL:F]That being said, were you[N]summoned by your father?[N][PAL:0] Yes[N] No[PAL:4]`

dialogstring_04EC76! `[CLR]Elder: What? If you[N]weren't summoned… Then was[N]the bad mark a mistake…?[END]`

dialogstring_04ECAB! `[CLR]Elder: I understand…[N]Well, [NAM:6]'s hunch was[N]right, wasn't it.[END]`

dialogstring_04ECCB! `[TPL:4][BOR:6][TPL:E]So, do you intend to go?[N][PAL:0] Yes[N] No[PAL:4]`

dialogstring_04ECEC! `[CLR]Elder: What. Unlike your[N]father, you're a meek[N]child.[END]`

dialogstring_04ED19! `[TPL:4][BOR:6][TPL:10]Elder: Very well. In that[N]case, I will entrust you[N]with the Incan idol that[N]is handed down in this[N]village.[FIN][CLD][TPL:4][BOR:6][TPL:E]The two idols will be the[N]key to unravel the[N]mysteries of the Inca…[FIN]They have passed through[N]human hands for many[N]hundreds of years.[FIN][TPL:F]One idol is enshrined in[N]the cave below. Muster up[N]your wisdom and you may[N]take it.[END]`

dialogstring_04EDF4! `[TPL:4][BOR:6][TPL:F]Elder: Oh…! That's[N]definitely the Incan idol![N]Wonderful; you've[N]discovered it![FIN][CLD][TPL:4][BOR:6][TPL:E]I think you might have[N]been born to discover the[N]mysteries of the Inca…[FIN]Anyway, I'll teach you a[N]legend that is handed down[N]in this village.[FIN][::][TPL:4][BOR:6][TPL:E]At the "Cliff of Laraiˮ,[N]underground beneath the[N]ruin.[FIN]Offer the Incan idols[N]where the breath of the[N]gods does not reach.[FIN]The valley wind will guide[N]you to the location of the[N]golden ship.[FIN]Did you understand that?[N][PAL:0] Yes[N] No[PAL:4]`

dialogstring_04EF1C! `[JMP:&dialogstring_04EDF4+M]`

dialogstring_04EF23! `[CLR]Elder: It is said that one[N]more is held by the Race[N]of the Moon.[FIN][NAM:2] will show you the[N]way there. Be careful.[END]`

dialogstring_04F277! `[TPL:3][TPL:E][NAM:6]: Hey, there was a[N]nice legend in this[N]village from long ago,[FIN][TPL:10]"A child with a virtuous[N]heart that wields the[N]Power of Darkness will[N]appear, and embark to save[N]the world…[FIN]When they appear, a great[N]Power of Darkness will[N]revive to graze the edge[N]of the Earth with a[N]gigantic comet…ˮ[FIN][CLD][TPL:3][TPL:E]These are the words handed[N]down through the Itory[N]clan.[END]`

dialogstring_04EFDF! `[TPL:4][TPL:D]Bill: Was the Elder still[N]doing well?[FIN][TPL:10]By the way, when you were[N]fighting demons in Edward[N]Castle's basement, didn't[N]you gather shining silver[N]stones?[FIN][CLD][TPL:4][TPL:D]I think those stones have[N]a mysterious power.[FIN][TPL:F]It seems that if you amass[N]100 of them, you will[N]immediately come to your[N]senses at a nearby place[FIN]…after being killed by an[N]enemy.[END]`

dialogstring_04E6E6! `[TPL:2][TPL:9][NAM:2]: Huh? The Race of[N]the Moon?[FIN][TPL:B]Yeah, I know them. They're[N]mysterious lifeforms that[N]better resemble shadows[N]rather than a race.[FIN]They dwell on the summit[N]of a tall, tall mountain[N]nearby, but…[FIN]…do you want to try[N]going there?[N][PAL:0] Yeah, I want to go[N] Actually, nevermind[PAL:4]`

dialogstring_04E78B! `[CLR][NAM:2]: Is that so. After[N]all, they say that those[N]who anger them lose their[N]lives.[FIN]Maybe it's better if you[N]don't, right?[END]`

dialogstring_04E778! `[CLD][TPL:2][TPL:9][NAM:2]: I understand.[N]Well, I'll guide you.[END]`

dialogstring_04E223! `[TPL:1][TPL:A][NAM:1]: I'm going too…![N]I want to try seeing the[N]Race of the Moon.[FIN]I want to experiencing[N]things with my own eyes[N]and ears,[FIN]…especially since I was[N]just barely able to escape[N]the castle.[END]`

dialogstring_04E7C9! `[TPL:2][TPL:A][NAM:2]: You can't…![N]It's too dangerous for a[N]little lady like you.[FIN]If you don't want to[N]bother [NAM:0], wait here[N]obediently.[FIN][TPL:1][TPL:A][NAM:1]: Hmph… Why…[N]I'm the only one being[N]left out.[FIN]I'll talk to Mrs. [NAM:6],[N]so it's okay![N]It's fiiiine…!![END]`

dialogstring_04E869! `[TPL:0][TPL:9][NAM:0]: Oh no, she's[N]pouting…[FIN][TPL:2][TPL:A][NAM:2]: It's just what the[N]doctor ordered for a[N]selfish little lady.[FIN]Alright, the mountain road[N]is difficult, but let's[N]tough it out.[FIN][CLD][TPL:A]Like this, [NAM:0] and [NAM:2][N]headed to the summit where[N]the Race of the Moon live.[END]`

;CHAPTER 8


------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'it1A_lily'
------------------------------
dialogstring_04F53C! `[TPL:2][TPL:A][NAM:2]: Alright, we've[N]arrived. This is the moon[N]race's habitat.[END]`

dialogstring_04F7C1! `[TPL:2][TPL:A][NAM:2]: Wait a second! We[N]came here because we had[N]an objective, didn't we?[FIN]We can't just go back all[N]of a sudden.[END]`

dialogstring_04F7F7! `[TPL:0][TPL:A][NAM:0]: (I can't go back[N]without obtaining the[N]Incan Figure, can I...)[END]`

------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'it1A_moon_tribe'
------------------------------
dialogstring_09D1FC! `[TPL:1A][TPL:E]Mysterious voice: Gooood[N]evening, gooood evening…[N]Goooing on a stroll?[FIN][TPL:0][TPL:E][NAM:0]: Who's there?![FIN][TPL:1A][TPL:E]Mysterious voice: Above,[N]above. This body is[N]lighter than air.[FIN][TPL:0][TPL:E][NAM:0]: What are you?![FIN][TPL:1A][TPL:F]Mysterious voice:[N]Try to guess.[WAI][N] Cotton candy's relative[N] Bird-human[N] Soul of a dead person…`

dialogstring_09D2D0! `[CLR]Mysterious voice:[N]Bzzzzzzzzzt… Wrong…[FIN]The truth is, we are the[N]moon race. Also known as[N]shadows.[END]`

dialogstring_09D388! `[TPL:1A][TPL:E]Moon race: The comet is[N]the destroyer of[N]everything.[FIN]That light causes all[N]living things to transform[N]… it isn't good light.[FIN][TPL:F]It's the remains of that[N]weapon from a distant,[N]ancient, terrible,[N]terrible war.[FIN][TPL:0][TPL:F][NAM:0]: The world becomes[N]terrible?[FIN][TPL:1A][TPL:F]Moon race: Exactly right.[N]You're clever, but you're[N]still young, boy.[END]`

dialogstring_09D30F! `[TPL:1A][TPL:E]Moon race: There are[N]always shadows in the[N]place that light is in.[FIN][TPL:F]Us that were transformed[N]by being completely[N]showered once by the[N]comet's light…[FIN]Since then, we are beings[N]that can quietly live in[N]a world without light.[END]`

code_09D1DD! {

}

dialogstring_09D462! `[TPL:1A][TPL:D]Moon race: Our one[N]companion was stolen.[FIN][TPL:F]Do you not know where to[N]go?[N][PAL:0] Yes[N] No`

dialogstring_09D4AD! `[CLR][PAL:4]Moon race: We may come[N]to chase you later.[N]Mweheheheheheheh…[END]`

dialogstring_09D4DC! `[TPL:1A][TPL:E]Of the comet's approach[N]every 800 years, this is[N]the 4th time.[FIN][TPL:F]The Power of Darkness[N]becomes stronger based on[N]the degree to which that[N]power showers…[FIN]What in the world will be[N]born from the light this[N]time…[END]`

Mweheheheheheheh…[END]`

---------------------------------------

--------------------------------------
dialogstring_05834D! `[TPL:1B][TPL:F]Her Majesty the Queen is[N]in the cabin. Please hurry[N]and show her how lively[N]you look.[END]`

?INCLUDE 'gs2E_sleep'
---------------------------------------
dialogstring_05870A! `[TPL:1B][TPL:E]Ah, Your Majesty. You're[N]sightseeing on the ship's[N]interior, right?[FIN]However, Your Majesty must[N]also be tired.[FIN]Once you've visited[N]everywhere, please rest in[N]this bed for a while.[END]`

---------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'gs2E_crew0'
---------------------------------------
dialogstring_0587A4! `[TPL:1B][TPL:E]Past this cavern embraced[N]by darkness, we can see a[N]dazzling light…[FIN][TPL:F]So that we could obtain[N]eternal freedom, we[N]departed to an ocean[N]filled in that light.[END]`

---------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'gs2E_crew3'
---------------------------------------

---------------------------------------

The[N][NAM:D] [NAM:E] is inside of[N]this box.[FIN]Moreover, it seems that we[N]should be prepared for[N]departure soon.[FIN][TPL:B]What will you do? Will you[N]climb the lookout tower[N]and take a look for[N]yourself?[FIN]You'll be able to watch[N]as we depart.[END]`

---------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'gs2E_crew1'
---------------------------------------
dialogstring_05883E! `[TPL:1B][TPL:12]Her Majesty, the Queen,[N]has carefully put on the[N]ring that Your Majesty had[N]bestowed upon her[N]previously.[FIN][CLD][TPL:1B][TPL:8]Ah, that's right.[FIN][TPL:B]Your Majesty sent the ring[N]when you and the Queen[N]were driven out by the[N]invaders and separated.[FIN]As for the Queen, she's[N]probably only concerned[N]with how well Your Majesty[N]is doing.[END]`

---------------------------------------
dialogstring_058A30! `[TPL:3][BOR:5][TPL:B]Incan Queen: How wonderful[N]that you've returned safe[N]and well for me, my[N]darling.[FIN]The [NAM:D] [NAM:E] of the[N]wind that you had spoken[N]of had protected me many[N]times until today![FIN]You said it was a stone[N]statue blessed by the[N]gods, right?[FIN][::][TPL:3][BOR:5][TPL:B]I believe it has been[N]placed in a treasure box[N]in the storehouse below;[FIN]please confirm it with[N]your own eyes.[END]`

---------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'gs2C_crow_crew'
---------------------------------------
dialogstring_0584BC! `[TPL:1B][TPL:E]Lookout: King, please look[N]outside. The ship is[N]leaving the cave![END]`

dialogstring_0584FB! `[TPL:1B][TPL:E]Lookout: We've been living[N]in darkness for a long[N]time.[FIN]For us, the light of the[N]gods is in the brightness[N]of this ocean.[FIN]Although these kinds of[N]beautiful things are in[N]the world,[FIN]I wonder why invaders are[N]born who destroy nature?[END]`

dialogstring_058759! `[TPL:1B][TPL:B]I'm sorry we only have a[N]humble bed like this this[N]to offer; please, take[N]your time and rest.[END]`

After[N]all, it might be cursed…![END]`

dialogstring_059D42! `[TPL:1][TPL:A][NAM:1]: You finally came[N]to, huh. We were split up[N]from everyone…[FIN]Are you hurt?[N][PAL:0] I'm fine[N] I'm still dizzy[PAL:4]`

dialogstring_059D91! `[TPL:B][NAM:1]: Is that so? It[N]seems like you recover[N]quickly, huh. You're like[N]a lizard's tail.[FIN][JMP:&dialogstring_059DCD+M]`

dialogstring_059DCD! `[CLR][NAM:1]: No wonder, right?[N]You were unconscious for[N]over half a day.[FIN][::][TPL:12]I've read stories of being[N]adrift in books, but I[N]would have thought it[N]ridiculous that it would[N]turn out like this for me.[FIN][CLD][TPL:1][TPL:A]I guess that disaster[N]comes around suddenly,[N]huh.[END]`

dialogstring_059E6F! `[TPL:1][TPL:9][NAM:1]: You know, I can't[N]help but worry.[FIN][TPL:A]Oh, you know, if we don't[N]think about the future, we[N]could enjoy being adrift…[FIN][TPL:B]I'm starving already.[N]Let's have the meat we[N]took from the castle's[N]basement for lunch.[END]`

------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'chunk_038000'
------------------------------------
dialogstring_038DDA! `[TPL:0][TPL:D]We bit into the bone-in[N]meat.[FIN][TPL:E]We felt that it was the[N]tastiest thing we had ever[N]eaten.[END]`

dialogstring_059CEB! `[DLG:9,7][SIZ:7,1]2nd Day Adrift[END]`

dialogstring_059EE3! `[TPL:1][TPL:B][NAM:1]: It's beautiful…[N]Even though I'm watching[N]it all day, I don't think[N]I'm getting tired of it…[END]`

dialogstring_059F2E! `[TPL:1][TPL:9][NAM:1]: How could you do[N]that…! Those poor fish…!![END]`

dialogstring_059F5A! `[TPL:0][TPL:9][DLY:0][NAM:0]: Time passed slowly[N]and uneventfully.[FIN][TPL:B][NAM:1] leisurely viewed the[N]fish all day long, but as[N]for me, well, I was full[N]of remorse.[FIN]I don't know how many[N]times I paced aimlessly[N]around the raft and tried[N]talking to [NAM:1].[FIN]A single minute felt like[N]hours…[FIN]It felt like I could hear[N]the footfalls of an[N]entirely carefree time[N]coming.[END]`

dialogstring_059CF9! `[DLG:9,7][SIZ:7,1]4th Day Adrift[END]`

dialogstring_05A03C! `[TPL:1][TPL:A][NAM:1]: Somehow I have a[N]hunch… That rescue might[N]be coming…[FIN]Oh…?[END]`

dialogstring_05A074! `[TPL:1][TPL:A][NAM:1]: It looks like[N]something is drifting[N]this way…![END]`

dialogstring_0599FC! `[PAL:0][TPL:A]Someone placed a letter[N]into this jar… It read[N]something like this.[FIN][TPL:5][BOR:1][DLG:3,4][SIZ:D,7]We have been placed on a[N]slave ship; it is heading[N]to unfamiliar land where[N]we will be sold.[N]If anyone reads this[N]letter, please save us…[N]                   [NAM:A][END]`

dialogstring_05A091! `[TPL:1][TPL:9][NAM:1]: Ah, although I had[N]that hunch…[FIN][TPL:A]They were saying[N]"save usˮ… But we also[N]want to be saved, right?[FIN]Ah, I'm totally famished[N]already…![FIN][TPL:0][TPL:B][NAM:0]: And that's why it[N]would have been better if[N]we'd eaten some fish last[N]time they were around.[FIN][CLD][TPL:0][TPL:8]So next time…[FIN][TPL:1][TPL:9][NAM:1]: You can't kill cute[N]fish like that![FIN][TPL:0][TPL:A][NAM:0]: Well then, are you[N]saying it's fine if don't[N]eat anything and die…!?[FIN][TPL:1][TPL:A][NAM:1]: The point is, I[N]can't eat raw fish! It's[N]gross![FIN]Besides, the fish are[N]trying as hard as they can[N]to survive…![FIN]The fish feel pain…! Do[N]you think about how the[N]fish feel…?![FIN][TPL:B]If you want to eat[N]something like that, go[N]ahead and eat it…! Because[N]I'm not going to…![END]`

dialogstring_05A232! `[TPL:1][TPL:8][NAM:1]: …[FIN][TPL:0][TPL:A][DLY:0][NAM:0]: That day, [NAM:1][N]wouldn't even give me the[N]sound of her voice…[FIN]Geez, the little lady is a[N]nuisance. Good grief…[END]`

dialogstring_059D07! `[DLG:9,7][SIZ:7,1]7th Day Adrift[END]`

dialogstring_05A291! `[PAU:1E][TPL:0][TPL:A][NAM:0]: First week adrift.[N]We came upon a school of[N]fish for a second time.[FIN]I'm already at the limit[N]of my strength.[FIN]I thought that if I didn't[N]eat now, I'd die…[END]`

dialogstring_05A319! `[TPL:1][TPL:8][NAM:1]: …[END]`

dialogstring_05A332! `[TPL:1][TPL:8][DLY:0][NAM:1]: …[FIN][TPL:A][NAM:0]… I'm sorry for[N]speaking like that[N]yesterday…[FIN][TPL:B]I'll try to eat a fish[N]too. Because if I die,[N]there's nothing more that[N]I can do, right?[FIN]It's only in comfortable[N]times where you're able to[N]avoid eating foods that[N]you dislike, huh…[FIN][TPL:0][TPL:B][NAM:0]: Allllright. Well,[N]I'll get a fish for you.[N]The tastiest one.[END]`

dialogstring_05A405! `[TPL:0][TPL:9][DLY:0][NAM:0]: [NAM:1] ate the[N]delicious-looking fish.[FIN][TPL:A]It seemed like I had come[N]to take a tiny bit of[N]concern about [NAM:1]…[END]`

dialogstring_059D15! `[DLG:8,7][SIZ:8,1]12th Day Adrift[END]`

dialogstring_05A467! `[TPL:1][TPL:D][NAM:1]: The stars are[N]beautiful, huh…[FIN][TPL:E]It seems like I could[N]touch them with my hands[N]if I was a little taller.[FIN][TPL:F]I think [NAM:2], [NAM:4] and[N]the rest must also be[N]looking at this same[N]starry sky.[FIN]If we could talk with the[N]stars, then we would[N]definitely know where[N]everyone is…[FIN][NAM:1]: Oh, that's right.[FIN]I noticed recently that[N]there's one more star[N]around the constellation[N]of Cygnus, the swan.[FIN]See, that red star over[N]there.[FIN]Hey. Won't you make a wish[N]on that star? I feel like[N]it will definitely come[N]true.[FIN][NAM:0], you close your eyes[N]tight and make a wish too,[N]okay?[END]`

dialogstring_05A5AB! `[TPL:0][TPL:B][DLY:0][NAM:0]: I tried praying as[N]hard as I could for[N]everyone's safety, and for[N]my dad…[END]`

dialogstring_059D24! `[DLG:8,7][SIZ:8,1]18th Day Adrift[END]`

dialogstring_05A5E3! `[TPL:1][TPL:A][NAM:1]: It's already nearly[N]three weeks since we went[N]adrift, huh?[FIN][TPL:B]Speaking of it, [NAM:0],[N]hasn't your hair grown a[N]little? Yeah, about two[N]pixels. (Laughs)[FIN][TPL:0][TPL:B][NAM:0]: Saying that, [NAM:1],[N]you don't feel like a[N]princess anymore.[FIN]I think if someone said[N]you were a girl from some[N]island, I wouldn't even[N]know.[FIN][CLD][TPL:1][TPL:8][NAM:1]: You're awwwfulll![FIN][TPL:9]W-what…? What's out there[N]in the water…?[END]`

dialogstring_05A723! `[TPL:1][TPL:B][NAM:1]: They're just[N]circling round and round[N]the raft; they're not[N]coming to attack…[FIN][TPL:0][TPL:B][NAM:0]: Let's observe the[N]situation for a bit.[END]`

dialogstring_05A6EA! `[TPL:1][TPL:9][NAM:1]: Could they be[N]sharks…?[FIN][TPL:A]I wonder if we'll be[N]eaten… What should we do…?[N][NAM:0]…[END]`

dialogstring_05A770! `[TPL:1][TPL:A][NAM:1]: I've got it! These[N]little fishies aren't[N]hungry![FIN]My butler taught something[N]to me a long time ago.[FIN]Humans are the only living[N]thing that attack when[N]they're not hungry.[FIN][TPL:0][TPL:B][NAM:0]: If that's the case,[N]then I guess what we're[N]doing is unusual for[N]humans.[FIN]After all, we didn't eat[N]any of the fish until we[N]were about to die, right?[FIN][TPL:1][TPL:B][NAM:1]: That's how it is,[N]huh? Ah, it looks like[N]they're leaving. Dear[N]sharks, farewellll…[END]`

dialogstring_059D33! `[DLG:8,7][SIZ:8,1]21st Day Adrift[END]`

dialogstring_05A853! `[TPL:1][TPL:A][NAM:1]: Hey, I want to tell[N]you something about[N]myself.[FIN]When I was at the castle,[N]I liked to look at the[N]setting sun…[FIN][TPL:B]When I saw the setting sun[N]from the castle's halls,[N]it was incredibly,[N]incredibly lovely…[FIN]But, you know. Now I've[N]come to hate it.[FIN]When the sun sets, then[N]the gloomy, frightful[N]darkness comes…[FIN]Because of that, I start[N]to think that I may never[N]be able to see the dawn[N]again…[FIN]But when you're here for[N]me, I can see lovely[N]morning light every day.[FIN]If you're here for me, I[N]feel that even challenging[N]times like these are fun[N]somehow.[FIN][TPL:0][TPL:B][NAM:0]: I actually wanted to[N]say something like that to[N][NAM:1], yet for some reason[N]the words didn't come out.[FIN]I only nodded and said[N]nothing…[END]`

dialogstring_05A9F9! `[TPL:0][TPL:A][NAM:0]: Suddenly, my knees[N]buckled; I collapsed and[N]lost consciousness…[FIN][CLD][TPL:1][TPL:9][DLY:0][NAM:1]: [NAM:0] …! [NAM:0] …![N]What's wrong…!?[FIN]Hold on…! Don't leave me[N]by myself…!![END]`

I don't[N]want to hear a scary story[N]like that![FIN][TPL:16][TPL:A]Man: Hahahaha. dialogstring_05AE00! `[TPL:0][TPL:D][NAM:0]: Huh… [NAM:1]…? Where in[N]the world are we? [FIN][TPL:1][TPL:D][NAM:1]: The house of a[N]gentleman that saved us.[FIN]Good grief, [NAM:0], you've[N]got bad sleeping posture…[FIN][TPL:E]You're supposed to be a[N]sick person and cling to[N]the sheets,[FIN]but you're laying on your[N]side like a baby.[END]`

dialogstring_05AF2F! `[TPL:1][TPL:A][NAM:1]: Anyhow, let's try[N]going to that city called[N][NAM:12].[FIN][TPL:B]I'm going to go give my[N]thanks to the dog. If[N]you're ready you can come[N]talk to me, alright?[END]`

dialogstring_05B94D! `[CLD][TPL:E][NAM:0] informed them of the[N]house where the slave is[N]hiding.[FIN][TPL:20][TPL:E]Man: Hey, thanks. Here's[N]your reward. Hang on to[N]it.[FIN][CLD][TPL:C][NAM:0] received a Red Jewel.[END]`

dialogstring_05BE6B! `[TPL:20][TPL:E]"From the sky will come a[N]great King of Terror… Then[N]humanity will die out.ˮ[FIN]I don't know where the[N]prophesy comes from, but[N]it's straight up lie.[FIN]I can go on without[N]drinking up that sort of[N]hogwash. *Hic*[END]`

--------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'fr3C_man1'
--------------------------------------
dialogstring_05C23F! `[TPL:20][TPL:A]I think "what if my life[N]turned out like theirsˮ[N]and shudder.[FIN]But I'm going to put all[N]my energy into my own[N]survival right now;[FIN]rather than concerning[N]myself with the feelings[N]of other people.[END]`

--------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'fr3C_man2'
--------------------------------------
dialogstring_05C2BE! `[TPL:20][TPL:E]These slaves are almost[N]exactly the same age as[N]you, huh?[FIN]I guess you'll remember[N]this…[FIN]In this world, even people[N]who are the same age as[N]you are living like this.[END]`

--------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'fr3C_slaver'
--------------------------------------
dialogstring_05C190! `[TPL:20][TPL:A]Hey boy…! This isn't a[N]place for children![N]Alright, go home, go home![FIN][TPL:B]Or, are you saying that[N]you came to buy a slave[N]too?[WAI][N][PAL:0] Yes [N] No[PAL:4]`

dialogstring_05C1E2! `[CLR]I'm starting to like your[N]courage! I don't know if[N]you're really buying or[N]what, but take a look.[END]`

dialogstring_05C21F! `[CLR]Well, go home, go home!![END]`

--------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'fr3C_imas'
--------------------------------------
dialogstring_05BF04! `[TPL:5][TPL:E]I'm [NAM:C]. I was brought[N]to this town from a[N]distant continent by ship.[FIN]We're a nation of hunters;[N]we survive by hunting when[N]we're hungry.[FIN][TPL:F]Recently, all the animals[N]are dropping dead from a[N]disease with no known[N]cause…[END]`

--------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'fr3C_remus'
--------------------------------------
dialogstring_05BFDE! `[TPL:5][TPL:F]I'm [NAM:B]. When there[N]were no longer any[N]animals, we no longer had[N]food.[FIN]And so, having no other[N]options, we became what[N]you call "slavesˮ in order[N]to survive.[FIN]We won't have any idea[N]what kind of person will[N]buy us or what kind of[N]place they'll bring us to…[END]`

dialogstring_05C059! `[TPL:20][TPL:E]O God… Why did you create[N]that thing called "social[N]statusˮ?[END]`

--------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'fr3C_sam'
--------------------------------------
dialogstring_05C094! `[TPL:5][TPL:C]I'm [NAM:A].[FIN][TPL:E]A boy named [NAM:3] that[N]works at the inn came to[N]save us last night.[FIN]But the slave merchants[N]found him and took him[N]away…[FIN]He's probably locked up in[N]the house at the edge of[N]the city's side street.[FIN]Please save him for me[N]somehow.[END]`

--------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'fr32_creep'

dialogstring_05CB93! `[TPL:3][TPL:B][NAM:3]: Even though I was[N]able to reunite with all[N]of you, I'm not crying[N]tears of joy.[FIN]I suppose that I've run[N]out of tears…[END]`

-------------------------------------

-------------------------------------
dialogstring_05C85E! `[TPL:4][TPL:8][DLY:2][NAM:4]: Where is this…?[FIN][TPL:1][TPL:9][NAM:1]: Somehow I'm feeling[N]very nostalgic…[FIN][TPL:3][TPL:9][NAM:3]: I feel as if I'm in[N]my mom's tummy…[FIN][TPL:2][TPL:B][NAM:2]: All of the people[N]that I've ever met and all[N]of the events I've ever[N]experienced from when I[N]was born are floating to[N]the surface of my mind one[N]by one…[FIN][TPL:4][TPL:B][DLY:2][NAM:4]: I was raised in tha[N]town o' South Cape[FIN]But didn't my old man go[N]out on an expedition and[N]not come back…?[FIN]Tha largest existence[N]within me had passed on,[N]and I suppose that I[N]didn't know what to do…[FIN][TPL:1][TPL:B][NAM:1]: I couldn't stand my[N]father invading other[N]countries with his troops.[FIN]It's a terrible thing when[N]people die, isn't it?[FIN]Years of life which they[N]had built up are reduced[N]to nothingness in an[N]instant.[FIN][TPL:3][TPL:B][NAM:3]: I wonder if [NAM:5][N]ultimately has died too…?[FIN][TPL:2][TPL:B][NAM:2]: They say that[N]people can forget[N]unpleasant things in order[N]to survive, don't they…?[END]`

dialogstring_05CA69! `[TPL:4][TPL:9][NAM:4]: Huh? What have I[N]been doin' until now?[FIN]Why are ya all over there?[FIN][TPL:2][TPL:9][NAM:2]: [NAM:4]! You've got[N]your memory back…![FIN][TPL:1][TPL:9][NAM:1]: Geez! You know, we[N]were worried about you!![FIN][TPL:3][TPL:9][NAM:3]: I had no idea what[N]was going to happen…[END]`

dialogstring_05CAEC! `[TPL:4][TPL:9][NAM:4]: I guess I made[N]everyone worry.[FIN][TPL:B]But if someone else ends[N]up in tha same position[N]next time, I'll take care[N]of them.[END]`

dialogstring_05CBF7! `[TPL:3][TPL:B][NAM:3]: I hear there is an[N]eccentric inventor in a[N]nearby forest; won't you[N]try to meet him?[FIN]Apparently it's a person[N]named Neil, but…[FIN][CLD][TPL:0][TPL:8][NAM:0]: You said it's Neil?![FIN][TPL:9]My cousin went missing; he[N]had the same name…!![FIN]My cousin Neil is also an[N]inventor.[FIN][TPL:B]He invented a vehicle that[N]can fly through the big[N]blue sky like a bird; it's[N]called an aeroplane.[FIN][CLD][TPL:A]Thus, [NAM:0]'s party headed[N]to the house of the[N]inventor in the forest.[END]`

-------------------------------------
dialogstring_05D984! `[PAU:1E][TPL:6][TPL:9]Neil: It's open, so come[N]in if you want…[FIN][TPL:0][TPL:9][NAM:0]: Neil. It's me. It's[N][NAM:0] from South Cape.[END]`

dialogstring_05D9C1! `[TPL:6][TPL:B]Neil: Oh…! Well, if it[N]isn't [NAM:0]…!! I guess[N]you've developed a[N]terribly resolute will.[FIN]With that, the rest of you[N]that are swarming in, are[N]you [NAM:0]'s friends?[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'na49_lily'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_05DDC0! `[TPL:1][TPL:9][NAM:1]: This guy kinda[N]stiiiinks…[END]`

dialogstring_05DDDF! `[TPL:2][TPL:B][NAM:2]: How can you say[N]something like that…!? You[N]should be able to word it[N]better…!![FIN]Come on, it's a wonderful[N]nose-irritating smell[N]drifting through the room[N]or something, right?[END]`

dialogstring_05DA04! `[TPL:6][TPL:A]Neil: Hey! You two little[N]ladies are both terribly[N]blunt, aren't you.[FIN][TPL:B]The thing is, you come not[N]to care about your[N]appearance when you're[N]focusing on inventing.[FIN]But I suppose I thought[N]that people wouldn't hate[N]my odour that much…[FIN]It still hasn't even been[N]past a month since I[N]started wearing these[N]socks.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'na49_lance'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_05E1EE! `[TPL:4][TPL:A][NAM:4]: My record's three[N]weeks, but I guess I'm[N]losing…[END]`
