?INCLUDE 'na49_kara'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_05E086! `[TPL:1][TPL:A][NAM:1]: Come on, I can't[N]even believe these[N]people…![FIN]It's gross that I've[N]already had to breathe[N]that same air…!![END]`

dialogstring_05DAC7! `[TPL:6][TPL:9]Neil: So, that's enough[N]about socks already…[FIN][TPL:B]Well, anyway, please[N]relax. I guess you must be[N][NAM:0]'s friends. Welcome to[N]my humble home.[END]`

dialogstring_05DB1C! `[TPL:6][TPL:A]I guess two years have[N]passed since meeting with[N]you, huh?[FIN]Since then, I've made some[N]terribly varied[N]inventions.[FIN]In this room, there are[N]just four inventions that[N]I'd like to boast of.[FIN]Search and take a look.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'na49_erik'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_05E2CE! `[TPL:3][TPL:A][NAM:3]: I guess [NAM:5] would[N]have been delighted to see[N]these inventions…[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'na49_tank'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_05E327! `[TPL:6][TPL:9]Neil: That's the oxygen[N]tank. I've put air inside.[FIN][TPL:A]If you're wearing that,[N]you can even breathe[N]underwater.[FIN]However, it can only hold[N]roughly a minute of air.[FIN]If I could compress the[N]air, you could probably[N]dive for a long time.[FIN]I haven't thought of a[N]method to do that yet.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'na49_wings'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_05E419! `[TPL:6][TPL:9]Neil: Those are aeroplane[N]wings.[FIN][TPL:B]It's a wonderful machine[N]that fulfills mankind's[N]dream of flying through[N]the air like a bird;[FIN]Those wings are just one[N]part of it.[FIN]The rest of the main body[N]is large, and even more[N]than that, it needs a[N]runway to take off.[FIN]So it's in the desert.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'na49_telescope'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_05E4F9! `[TPL:6][TPL:8]That's the telescope.[FIN][TPL:B]With it, you can see the[N]stars of the heavens as if[N]you could take them in[N]your hand.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'na49_camera'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_05E55C! `[TPL:6][TPL:8]That's the camera.[FIN][TPL:B]It's a device that can[N]burn an identical image of[N]the landscape onto[N]photographic paper.[FIN]The flaw is that copying[N]it takes nearly 30[N]minutes.[FIN]The landscape doesn't move[N]so that's fine;[FIN]But people have to go on[N]without even blinking for[N]30 minutes when you're[N]photographing them.[FIN]The image of your eyes[N]ends up turning bright red[N]like a rabbit's when using[N]this device.[END]`

dialogstring_05DD04! `[TPL:6][TPL:9]Neil: [NAM:0], where are you[N]going?[FIN][TPL:B]You took the trouble of[N]coming here, so relax a[N]while longer before you[N]go.[END]`

dialogstring_05DB9C! `[TPL:6][TPL:B]Anyway, you came here[N]because I can do something[N]for you, right? Please[N]tell me what you need.[FIN][TPL:0][TPL:B][NAM:0] told Neil about the[N]events that happened until[N]now; hearing the voice of[N]his missing father,[FIN]searching for the [NAM:D][N][NAM:E]s that are spread[N]across ruins throughout[N]the world, and so on.[FIN][CLD][TPL:6][TPL:A]Neil: Hohoho… I think[N]that's a very interesting[N]story…[FIN]I'm a little interested in[N]ancient ruins too, you[N]know?[FIN]The ruins that you've told[N]me are scattered all over[N]the world…[FIN]But there's a mysterious[N]connection between them.[FIN][TPL:B]If you draw a line on the[N]world map between all the[N]ruins you've been to so[N]far…[FIN]…it somehow forms a huge[N]image of the constellation[N]of Cygnus, the swan.[END]`

dialogstring_05E0C1! `[TPL:1][TPL:9][NAM:1]: You said it was[N]Cygnus?![FIN][TPL:6][TPL:B]Neil: Right. Beyond that,[N]the Tower of Babel that[N][NAM:0]'s dad was said to have[N]disappeared in,[FIN]…ends up being exactly in[N]the middle of that giant[N]swan.[END]`

dialogstring_05DE46! `[TPL:2][TPL:B][NAM:2]: Well, now that you[N]mention it, there's been a[N]new red star underneath[N]Cygnus as of late…[FIN][TPL:6][TPL:B]Neil: Exactly…! You know a[N]lot, don't you?[FIN]Between the new star[N]appearing in Cygnus and[N][NAM:0]'s talk of ruins,[FIN]these various elements are[N]tied together too neatly[N]for it to happen[N]organically…[FIN][TPL:12]I don't know if it's[N]coincidence or conspiracy,[N]but the fact is that[N]something is going to[N]happen.[FIN][CLD][TPL:6][TPL:9]However, the circumstances[N]are good.[FIN][TPL:B]The desert of the Nazca[N]lines is at most a day's[N]walk to the east from[N]here.[FIN][::]Will you check it out?[N][PAL:0] Yes[N] No[PAL:4]`

dialogstring_05DF9F! `[CLR]Neil: Hey, don't say that.[N]You know, to tell you the[N]truth, I want to go[N]myself.[FIN][JMP:&dialogstring_05DE46+M]`

dialogstring_05DFC3! `[CLR]Neil: Alright…! I guess[N]it's settled then.[END]`

dialogstring_05E227! `[TPL:4][TPL:8][NAM:4]: We're going too…![FIN][TPL:9][NAM:0] won't be tha only one[N]who can have fun memories.[FIN][CLD][TPL:9]The party headed to the[N]Nazca desert…[END]`

dialogstring_05DFDC! `[TPL:2][TPL:B][NAM:2]: He's [NAM:0]'s cousin[N]so I won't speak ill of[N]him, but isn't this guy an[N]inventor…?[END]`

projectFiles.name: chapter17
projectFiles.text:
;CHAPTER 17

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'na4B_neil'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_05E8F7! `[TPL:6][TPL:E]Neil: It was a long walk,[N]but I think everyone held[N]up well.[FIN][TPL:F]This is the most famous[N]image of the Nazca lines,[N]the condor. You've at[N]least heard of it, right?[FIN]We still don't know why in[N]the world the people of[N]ancient times drew things[N]like this.[FIN]Well, anyhow. Even if you[N]travel here, the scale of[N]the area can overwhelm[N]you.[FIN]Before anything else,[N]everyone may want take a[N]look by themselves first.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'na4B_lily'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_05F0C8! `[TPL:2][TPL:F][NAM:2]: Awesome, aren't[N]they? The people from[N]ancient times. How could[N]they have drawn these…?[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'na4B_lance'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_05EF2D! `[TPL:4][TPL:F][NAM:4]: I suppose that[N]until tha other day, I've[N]been spendin' all o' my[N]days doin' things like…[FIN]commutin' to and from[N]school, studyin', and[N]playin'.[FIN]I couldn't even dream that[N]I'd be here…[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'na4B_erik'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_05F278! `[TPL:3][TPL:E][NAM:3]: I'm scared for some[N]reason… I'll be close to[N]Neil.[END]`

dialogstring_05E9F0! `[TPL:6][TPL:E]Neil: Ha ha ha. Don't rush[N]like that. Go sightseeing[N]with everyone first.[END]`

dialogstring_05EDA1! `[TPL:1][TPL:10][NAM:1]: If you look at it[N]like this, it looks kind[N]of like the white lines on[N]a school playground on[N]track and field day.[FIN][CLD][TPL:1][TPL:F]Surprisingly, the ancient[N]Nazca people were doing[N]the 100-meter dash here,[N]weren't they?[END]`

dialogstring_05F0FE! `[TPL:2][TPL:E][NAM:2]: Isn't it somehow[N]natural how these stones[N]are scattered around?[END]`

dialogstring_05EE15! `[TPL:1][TPL:E][NAM:1]: This is exactly[N]where the condor's stomach[N]would be, isn't it?[FIN][TPL:F]Don't you think that if[N]you dig here, you'll find[N]eggs or something like[N]that?[FIN]I-I'm joking. (Laughs) I'm[N]not really going to search[N]for them.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'na4B_spirit'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_05F349! `[TPL:1A][TPL:C]Mweheheheheheh…[END]`

dialogstring_05ED60! `[TPL:1][TPL:F][NAM:1]: It probably feels[N]great to draw a huge[N]picture on a natural[N]canvas like this,[FIN]…being able to feel the[N]wind, having nothing else[N]to distract you.[END]`

dialogstring_05F29F! `[TPL:3][TPL:E][NAM:3]: What's going to[N]happen…? I'm getting[N]excited.[END]`

dialogstring_05F2C7! `[TPL:3][TPL:E][NAM:3]: What's going to[N]happen…? I'm getting[N]excited.[END]`

dialogstring_05EA25! `[TPL:6][TPL:E]Neil: Aaallright, now that[N]everyone's back, let's get[N]to the main question.[FIN][TPL:10]The thing that [NAM:0] was[N]calling a [NAM:D] [NAM:E][N]is probably going to be[N]somewhere in this plain,[N]right?[FIN][CLD][PAU:28][TPL:3][TPL:F][NAM:3]: The thought came to[N]me when I was looking at[N]the drawing on the ground[N]just now;[FIN]don't you think that you[N]can kind of see the form[N]of a swan in this condor[N]image?[FIN][CLD][PAU:14][TPL:6][TPL:D]Neil: That's it…! You've[N]figured it out…!![FIN][TPL:F]We've been comparing the[N]arrangement of the stars[N]in that constellation to a[N]swan,[FIN]…but as far as the ancient[N]people of Nazca were[N]concerned, it might have[N]been a condor.[END]`

dialogstring_05F148! `[TPL:2][TPL:D][NAM:2]: Aaaaaaaaaaah…!![N]I've got it…!![END]`

dialogstring_05F160! `[PAU:28][TPL:2][TPL:E][DLY:0]Look, look…! The location[N]of the stones on the[N]surface of the ground…!![FIN][TPL:F]They're definitely in the[N]positions of the stars in[N]the constellation of[N]Cygnus…![END]`

dialogstring_05EB2E! `[TPL:6][TPL:E]Neil: [N]we'll talk about it when[N]everyone comes back.[FIN][::][TPL:6][TPL:C][DLY:0]Neil: That's it…![FIN][TPL:F]There are nine stars in[N]the constellation of[N]Cygnus, and there are also[N]nine stones…[FIN]`

dialogstring_068BB6! `[TPL:16][TPL:9]I got a taste of what it's[N]like to die just now.[FIN][TPL:A]Having an experience even[N]that close to death is a[N]terrifying thing…[FIN]It isn't your fault[N]because you didn't know[N]what was going on,[FIN]…but I wonder if the[N]animals we eat for food[N]also feel that sensation.[END]`

dialogstring_06A0EC! `[TPL:17][TPL:F]One year after we saw the[N]light of the gods, our[N]bodies started to undergo[N]a change.[FIN]Some people became thin,[N]some people grew to look[N]like boulders,[FIN]…and some people even[N]melted away so that they[N]looked like water…[END]`

dialogstring_06A1C9! `[TPL:17][TPL:D]We couldn't bear this[N]awful state of affairs,[FIN][TPL:E]…so there were more than a[N]few people who thought we[N]should escape from here.[FIN]However, the continent of[N]Mu is an island on the[N]deep blue sea.[FIN][TPL:F]Beyond that, there was no[N]guarantee that we would[N]have arrived in some other[N]place where we could live…[FIN]This island did not have[N]the material for a ship.[FIN]It would immediately sink[N]if we had constructed it[N]from stone…[END]`

dialogstring_06A19E! `[TPL:17][TPL:E]What meaning would there[N]even be in going on living[N]if it went on like this…?[END]`

dialogstring_06A4E9! `[TPL:0][TPL:E]It seems that both a red[N]wire and a blue wire are[N]hanging out of the bomb…[FIN]Which will you cut?[N][PAL:0] Go with red[N] Go with blue[PAL:4]`

dialogstring_06A54E! `[CLR]The red wire is cut![END]`

dialogstring_06A566! `[CLR]The blue wire is cut![END]`

dialogstring_06A719! `[DEF][TPL:0]...........[FIN]It was a dud.[N]I'm saved...[PAL:0][END]`

dialogstring_06A57F! `[PAU:28][TPL:0][TPL:D][NAM:0]: It looks like the[N]bomb stopped somehow…[FIN][TPL:3][TPL:D][NAM:3]: I'm saaaved…[FIN][CLD][TPL:D][NAM:2] begins to speak[N]from your pocket.[FIN][TPL:2][TPL:E][NAM:2]: Sorry [NAM:0]… Even[N]though I was with you, I[N]couldn't do anything…[FIN]My legs froze and couldn't[N]move at all, even my voice[N]wouldn't come out…[FIN]You're a boy after all,[N]aren't you.[FIN][TPL:F]I thought I was reliable[N]until now, but this is how[N]it is when it comes down[N]to it…[FIN]…Sorry, I'll still take up[N]your pocket for a while.[END]`

dialogstring_06A3B8! `[TPL:3][TPL:D][NAM:3]: I won't tell anyone[N]that you transformed.[END]`

----------------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'mu67_neil_lily'
----------------------------------------------
dialogstring_06A7C7! `[TPL:6][TPL:9]Neil: [NAM:0]! Are you[N]safe…?![FIN][TPL:4][TPL:A][NAM:4]: [NAM:0]…! I couldn't[N]see any sign of [NAM:2];[N]how's she doin'…?![FIN][TPL:2][TPL:A][NAM:2]: I'm here…[END]`

dialogstring_06AA4C! `[TPL:2][TPL:A][NAM:2]: Sorry for making[N]you worry. But I had [NAM:0][N]to protect me so I'm okay…[END]`

dialogstring_06AA89! `[TPL:6][TPL:A]Neil: Oh? [NAM:0]'s turned[N]out to be very manly too,[N]hasn't he?[END]`

----------------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'mu67_kara'
----------------------------------------------
dialogstring_06A894! `[TPL:1][TPL:9][NAM:1]: Who cares about[N]that![FIN][TPL:A]More importantly, let's[N]think how to get off of[N]the continent of Mu…![FIN][TPL:2][TPL:A][NAM:2]: You don't have to[N]worry about that.[FIN][TPL:B]We heard something good[N]from someone just now;[N]they were named [NAM:14] or[N]something like that.[FIN][CLD][TPL:12][NAM:0] told everyone about[N]the continent of Mu, the[N]people who crossed over[N]through the undersea[N]tunnel, and so on…[FIN][CLD][TPL:1][TPL:9][NAM:1]: It's a sad story,[N]isn't it…?[FIN][TPL:A]The people who were living[N]here together were[N]scattered,[FIN][TPL:B]and even more so when once[N]they arrive at the other[N]side on the bottom of the[N]sea…[FIN][TPL:6][TPL:B]Neil: Anyway, if we pass[N]through that undersea[N]tunnel, then we should be[N]able to get out, right?[FIN][TPL:4][TPL:B][NAM:4]: Alright…! If we've[N]decided on that, let's go[N]immediately…![END]`

projectFiles.text:
;CHAPTER 21


----------------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'st68_neil'
----------------------------------------------
dialogstring_06AB53! `[TPL:0][TPL:A]Five days passed since we[N]entered the undersea[N]tunnel.[FIN][TPL:B]The scenery looks the same[N]no matter how much you[N]walk. We began to feel[N]overwhelmed…[FIN][CLD][PAU:28][TPL:6][TPL:9]Neil: How about we rest[N]here for today?[FIN][TPL:3][TPL:A][NAM:3]: I'm exhaaausted. I[N]think we walked about a[N]thousand kilometres today.[FIN][TPL:4][TPL:A][NAM:4]: Don't be stupid.[N]Human legs can't walk that[N]far.[FIN][TPL:1][TPL:A][NAM:1]: Geez, I can't stand[N]it…![FIN]This journey's been[N]nothing but one exhausting[N]event after another…[FIN][TPL:2][TPL:A][NAM:2]: Everybody's[N]thinking the same thing,[N]so be quiet…![FIN]More importantly, let's[N]eat. I'm hungry.[END]`

----------------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'st68_erik'
----------------------------------------------
dialogstring_06AE70! `[TPL:3][TPL:9][NAM:3]: I'm peeing, so don't[N]come look![END]`

----------------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'st68_lance'
----------------------------------------------
dialogstring_06AF03! `[TPL:4][TPL:A][NAM:4]: Where tha heck does[N]this underground tunnel go[N]on to…[END]`

dialogstring_06ACB9! `[TPL:6][TPL:B]Neil: I guess millennia[N]ago, there must have been[N]people walking through[N]this underground tunnel.[FIN]I can't help but think of[N]myself a little when I[N]think of the distant past.[END]`

----------------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'st68_lily'
----------------------------------------------
dialogstring_06B57D! `[TPL:2][TPL:9][NAM:2]: Humans are[N]mysterious, aren't we…?[FIN][TPL:12]When you're pushed to the[N]absolute limit, you might[N]know with a glance if[N]something is edible or if[N]it's poisonous.[FIN][CLD][TPL:2][TPL:A]I wonder if it was that[N]was for the people of the[N]past.[END]`

----------------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'st68_kara'
----------------------------------------------
dialogstring_06B069! `[TPL:1][TPL:A][NAM:1]: Aah, I want to eat[N]a steak…! I want to eat a[N]salad…!![FIN]My skin is already turning[N]dry because we're only[N]eating weird things…[END]`

----------------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'st68_mushrooms'
----------------------------------------------
dialogstring_06B86E! `[TPL:0][TPL:A]We found these mushrooms[N]living in this tunnel when[N]we arrived.[FIN]They're our only source of[N]food.[FIN][TPL:B]Yesterday was fried[N]mushrooms. The day before[N]yesterday was boiled[N]mushrooms.[FIN]When we ate them raw three[N]days ago and they were[N]frightfully disgusting…[FIN]But we can't concern[N]ourselves with luxuries[N]like flavour.[FIN]We're being patient in[N]order to live, but when it[N]comes to having an empty[N]stomach…[END]`

dialogstring_06B0BC! `[TPL:1][TPL:9][NAM:1]: Oh gosh. [NAM:0] found[N]mushrooms again…[FIN][TPL:2][TPL:B][NAM:2]: You have to think[N]of it as being better than[N]starving to death.[N]Alright, let's eat…[END]`

dialogstring_06AE88! `[TPL:0][TPL:9]Like this, one day again[N]passed slowly…[END]`

dialogstring_06B606! `[TPL:0][TPL:9]Eighth day since entering[N]the tunnel. [FIN][TPL:A]Unable to sleep, I was[N]staring at an underground[N]water stream…[END]`

dialogstring_06B661! `[TPL:2][TPL:8][NAM:2]: Can't sleep?[END]`

dialogstring_06B67B! `[PAU:1E][TPL:0][TPL:A][NAM:0]: Yeah, it's because[N]I'm getting hungry.[N]…I'm kidding.[FIN][TPL:2][TPL:B][NAM:2]: Speaking of, [NAM:0].[N]As our journey continues,[N]we've changed a lot,[N]haven't we?[FIN]You could say that we've[N]matured somehow.[FIN][TPL:0][TPL:B][NAM:0]: I don't understand[N]it well myself, but…[FIN]I'm able to use mysterious[N]powers; you've seen me[N]transform into the form of[N]a warrior, right?[FIN]After the expedition with[N]my dad at the Tower of[N]Babel, my body had[N]changed.[FIN]I have a hunch that I'll[N]understand the secrets of[N]my power through this[N]journey.[FIN]By the way, [NAM:2], why[N]did you tag along in such[N]a dangerous journey?[FIN][TPL:2][TPL:B][NAM:2]: At first, it was[N]half for fun. But now it's[N]a private matter. Ehehe.[FIN]Since we won't be able to[N]avoid a lot of walking[N]tomorrow… I'll be going to[N]bed soon, okay?[END]`

dialogstring_06AD22! `[TPL:0][TPL:A]Two weeks since entering[N]the undersea tunnel. We[N]still can't see an exit…[END]`

dialogstring_06AD64! `[TPL:1][TPL:B][NAM:1]: Hey hey. Were there[N]eerie sounds coming from[N]above the tunnel when we[N]were sleeping last night?[FIN][TPL:4][NAM:4]: I think ya often[N]notice those sort o'[N]sounds… That ain't it; ya[N]were just gettin' tired.[END]`

dialogstring_06B10B! `[TPL:1][TPL:B][NAM:1]: Listen… You can[N]hear it even now…! I[N]wonder what it is… That[N]sound…[END]`

dialogstring_06B13C! `[TPL:3][TPL:9][NAM:3]: Could it be a[N]Leviathan…?[FIN][TPL:1][TPL:9][DLY:0][NAM:1]: This is bad…!![N]Run away!![FIN][TPL:2][TPL:A][NAM:2]: You can tell us to[N]run away, but where the[N]heck do we run to…!?[END]`

dialogstring_06B195! `[TPL:6][TPL:A]Neil: Everyone, be quiet…![N]This repeating vibration[N]sound…[FIN]This is Morse code…[FIN][TPL:B]When boats contact each[N]other, they use signals[N]where the length of sounds[N]map up to words.[FIN]I can try to decode a bit[N]of it, so please wait…[END]`

dialogstring_06B250! `[TPL:5][TPL:8][DLY:4]I'm [NAM:5]…[FIN][TPL:4][TPL:9][DLY:0][NAM:4]: Did ya say it's[N][NAM:5]?![FIN][TPL:2][TPL:9][DLY:0][NAM:2]: Shh… Be quiet…[N][PAU:3C][DLY:0]Neil's about to continue.[FIN][TPL:5][TPL:9][DLY:4]I was swallowed by a[N]Leviathan…[FIN][TPL:B]And then, when I regained[N]consciousness, my body had[N]been transformed into the[N]form of a Leviathan.[FIN]These life forms that we[N]call Leviathans may be[N]understood as humans that[N]live in the sea.[FIN]From what my fellow[N]Leviathans say, the light[N]of the comet distorts the[N]evolution of living things[N]or something like that.[FIN]I'd join you on your[N]journey again, but my[N]body's like this, so…[FIN]Please stay strong anyway,[N]and bring the mysteries of[N]the comet and the ruins to[N]light…[END]`

dialogstring_06B3EC! `[TPL:6][TPL:9]Neil: I can't hear it[N]anymore…[FIN][TPL:1][TPL:9][NAM:1]: [NAM:5]… I pity him…[FIN][TPL:4][TPL:A][NAM:4]: Now that ya mention[N]it, I guess that guy must[N]have studied Morse code.[FIN][NAM:5] has learned[N]sophisticated things too,[N]hadn't he.[FIN][TPL:3][TPL:A][NAM:3]: But [NAM:5] no longer[N]is in human form…!![FIN][TPL:6][TPL:A]Neil: Nah, [NAM:3]. I don't[N]think you should assume[N]it's a bad thing.[FIN][TPL:B]We may only think that[N]the human body is the best[N]one because we're just[N]humans.[FIN]Alright. Keep your spirits[N]up and let's go ahead!![END]`

dialogstring_06BAFA! `[TPL:6][TPL:9]Neil: I guess we've[N]finally arrived.[FIN][TPL:A]I think we were walking in[N]the undersea tunnel for[N]about a month in the end…[FIN][TPL:4][TPL:A][NAM:4]: Huh? There's a[N]bulletin board.[END]`

dialogstring_06BB50! `[TPL:4][TPL:B][NAM:4]: Let's see here.[N]Fallen angel clan?[N]Travelers, please use[N]this room?[FIN][TPL:6][TPL:B]Neil: So the people living[N]in this place are called[N]the fallen angel clan…[FIN]Neil: I guess they put up[N]that sign because they[N]don't want to meet people[N]themselves.[FIN]Before anything else,[N]shall we try to get some[N]rest in that room…?[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'av69_lily'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_06C224! `[TPL:2][TPL:8][NAM:2]: [NAM:0]. Let's go…[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'av69_kara'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_06C3B1! `[TPL:1][TPL:9][NAM:1]: What is this[N]"[NAM:0], let's goˮ…![FIN]You too, [NAM:0]![N]You're flirting.[FIN][TPL:A]I'm going sightseeing[N]alone! Don't come with[N]me…!![END]`

dialogstring_06C23C! `[TPL:2][TPL:9][NAM:2]: What is she so[N]touchy about…[FIN][TPL:4][TPL:A][NAM:4]: Geez, always tha[N]fickle little lady. Leave[N]her alone, I guess.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'av69_signs'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_06BA36! `[TPL:1D][BOR:1][TPL:E]        Travelers:[N]   Please use this room[N]    Fallen Angel Clan[END]`

dialogstring_06BA6B! `[TPL:1D][BOR:1][TPL:D]Entrance to fallen[N]angel's town[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'av6A_lance'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_06BC5C! `[TPL:4][TPL:A][NAM:4]: [NAM:0]. Tha thing is,[N]I've got somethin' to[N]discuss with ya…[FIN]I hate to say it, but it[N]seems like I've developed[N]feelin's for [NAM:2]…[FIN][TPL:B]Even when I dream, I only[N]dream o' her… Before I[N]knew it, she had caught[N]my eye.[FIN]Ya think that's not like[N]me, right?[N][PAL:0] Yeah…[N] That isn't true`

dialogstring_06BD1A! `[CLR][TPL:0][TPL:B][NAM:0]: That's right. I've[N]never thought that you'd[N]be saying things like[N]that.[FIN]`

dialogstring_06BD4A! `[CLR][TPL:0][TPL:B][NAM:0]: But you've spent a[N]lot of time together by[N]now.[FIN]It wouldn't be unnatural[N]even to be in love with[N]her.[FIN][TPL:4][TPL:B][NAM:4]: Speakin' o' that.[N]It seems like [NAM:2]'s[N]fifteenth birthday is[N]comin' up soon.[FIN]I want to tell her my[N]feelin's with a present[N]then, but what do ya think[N]I should go with?[FIN][PAL:0] A pretty bouquet[N] A wonderful necklace[N] A tender kiss[PAL:4]`

dialogstring_06BE1F! `[CLR][TPL:0][TPL:B][NAM:0]: I don't think[N]there's a girl out there[N]who wouldn't be happy to[N]get a bouquet of flowers.[FIN][TPL:4][TPL:B][NAM:4]: I guess that's[N]expected.[FIN][TPL:12]Well, I think I can try[N]to communicate a love[N]confession through tha'[N]language of flowers;[N]rosebuds.[FIN][CLD][JMP:&dialogstring_06BF7C]`

dialogstring_06BE85! `[CLR][TPL:0][TPL:B][NAM:0]: Of course, shouldn't[N]it be something that she[N]regularly wears?[FIN]Because whenever she sees[N]it, she'll think about how[N][NAM:4] is doing.[FIN][TPL:4][NAM:4]: Ah, I get it.[FIN][TPL:B]Well then, I'll try[N]searching for pretty[N]stones or something like[N]that and making a necklace.[FIN][JMP:&dialogstring_06BF7C]`

dialogstring_06BF0A! `[CLR][TPL:0][TPL:B][NAM:0]: If you truly like[N]her there's nothing else[N]but this, right?[FIN][TPL:4][TPL:B][NAM:4]: I feel like doing[N]that all of a sudden would[N]be too bold, but if you[N]say so, should I try it…?[FIN][JMP:&dialogstring_06BF7C]`

dialogstring_06BF7C! `[TPL:4][TPL:B][NAM:4]: Thanks fer lending[N]me yer advice.[FIN]I'll try to think of it[N]in my own way. Good[N]friends are nice to have,[N]ain't they.[END]`

dialogstring_06C2BD! `[TPL:2][TPL:B][NAM:2]: The people that[N]call themselves the fallen[N]angel clan live in a[N]gloomy place like this.[FIN]It seems depressing…[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'av6A_erik'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_06C52F! `[TPL:3][TPL:9][NAM:3]: Sunlight is[N]iiincredibly bright.[FIN][TPL:A]Even though I've always[N]had it around, I hadn't[N]noticed.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'av6A_neil'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_06C0D2! `[TPL:6][TPL:B]Neil: I had been thinking,[N]mustn't the fallen angel[N]clan be the descendants[N]of the Mu people?[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'av6B_villagers1'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_06C799! `[TPL:1D][TPL:9]This is the fallen angels'[N]village.[FIN][TPL:A]Our bodies are weak; we'd[N]die even if we were in the[N]sunlight for too long.[END]`
dialogstring_06C7EF! `[TPL:1D][TPL:9]This is the fallen angels'[N]village.[FIN][TPL:A]Our bodies are weak; we'd[N]die even if we were in the[N]sunlight for too long.[END]`
dialogstring_06C845! `[TPL:1D][TPL:9]This is the fallen angels'[N]village.[FIN][TPL:A]Our bodies are weak; we'd[N]die even if we were in the[N]sunlight for too long.[END]`
dialogstring_06C9BF! `[TPL:1D][TPL:9]This is the fallen angels'[N]village.[FIN][TPL:A]Our bodies are weak; we'd[N]die even if we were in the[N]sunlight for too long.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'av6B_villagers3'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_06CBEE! `[TPL:1D][TPL:9]There are stories that say[N]we evolved from humans.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'av6B_villagers2'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_06CB5E! `[TPL:1D][TPL:9]A short time ago, a human[N]girl came here.[FIN]Her name was [NAM:1] or[N]something like that.[FIN][TPL:A]It seems that she went to[N]the studio of the artist,[N]Ishtar.[FIN]His paintings are praised[N]for their beauty, you[N]know?[END]`

dialogstring_06CC22! `[TPL:1D][TPL:A]I'll teach you the route[N]to the studio, so remember[N]it, alright?[FIN]First of all,[N]follow the wind.[FIN][TPL:B]You'll understand if you[N]look at which direction[N]the flames of the torches[N]are bending in.[FIN]You can hear the sound of[N]a waterfall where the[N]strong wind storms through[N]the dark passage.[FIN]Subsequently, please[N]examine the area where[N]the waterfall's sound is[N]the loudest.[FIN]Ishtar's studio is beyond[N]there. Be careful,[N]alright?[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'av6C_villagers4'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_06CA5C! `[TPL:1D][TPL:A]This is something called[N]"danceˮ; a way that humans[N]amuse themselves.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'av6C_villagers5'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_06CD9A! `[TPL:1D][TPL:A]We want to get closer to[N]human emotions, so we[N]dance like this every day.[FIN]Even so, nothing changes…[END]`

dialogstring_06CA71! `[TPL:1D][TPL:A]The picture attached to[N]that wall was painted by[N]an artist called Ishtar.[FIN]However, the models for[N]his pictures go missing[N]afterward…[END]`

dialogstring_06CDD4! `[TPL:1D][TPL:B]Though we lack emotions,[N]Ishtar draws us[N]overflowing with human[N]kindness.[FIN][TPL:12]There is no end to the[N]people who want Ishtar to[N]draw them even though they[N]don't know what will[N]happen to them afterward.[END]`

dialogstring_06CE56! `[TPL:1D][TPL:A]The person who was my[N]dance partner is now[N]inside of that painting.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'av6B_ocean_ache'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_06C714! `[TPL:1D][TPL:A]We don't know from what[N]era we started living[N]here.[FIN]But our chests hurt for[N]some reason when we see[N]the ocean.[END]`

dialogstring_06CB07! `[TPL:1D][TPL:8]We have no emotions…[FIN][TPL:9]We never laugh or cry from[N]the day we are born.[FIN]In our lives,[N]every day is the same…[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'av6B_musician'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_06D0C6! `[TPL:1D][TPL:A]Woman playing the harp:[N]Music is the greatest[N]medicine for the soul.[FIN][TPL:B]No matter what disease you[N]face, you will become well[N]if you hear a wonderful[N]composition.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'jeweler_gem'
-------------------------------------

dialogstring_08D459! `[CLR]Whoops, the number of[N]jewels you've collected[N]have passed 20, haven't[N]they…![FIN]Going by the list, I'll[N]give you Psycho Power.[FIN]This is a mysterious,[N]otherworldly power that I[N]will award you from my[N]soul.[FIN]It seems like the Psycho[N]Dash's attack power rose.[FIN]`

;Psycho Slider / Performs a sliding attack. Can pass through narrow passages.

dialogstring_06C981! `[TPL:1D][TPL:E]I'm a sculptor. Before I[N]die, I intend to make a[N]thousand of these statues…[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'av6C_only_sleeping'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_06D063! `[TPL:0][TPL:A][NAM:0]: They have no[N]consciousness, as if their[N]soul had been removed…[END]`

dialogstring_06C8B0! `[TPL:1D][TPL:F]Do you know the painter,[N]Ishtar?[N][PAL:0] Yes[N] No[PAL:4]`

dialogstring_06C8DC! `[CLR]In that case, you should[N]listen a little more to[N]what everyone has to say.[END]`

dialogstring_06C8F7! `[CLR]The studio of Ishtar, the[N]painter, is on the other[N]side of this door.[FIN][TPL:10]But there are creatures[N]with nothing but hatred[N]and a desire for[N]destruction which are[N]roaming beyond this point.[FIN][CLD][TPL:1D][TPL:E]If you say you still want[N]to go despite that, you[N]may open the door.[END]`

;CHAPTER 23

-------------------------------------
dialogstring_06CEF2! `[TPL:3][TPL:B]Ishtar: You came to take[N]back that girl, haven't[N]you? She was named [NAM:1][N]or something.[FIN]You should go to the rooms[N]ahead of here in that[N]case.[FIN]If you can solve all of[N]the mysteries, I'll[N]restore that girl to[N]normal.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'av75_apprentice'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_06DC97! `[TPL:1D][TPL:B]Ishtar's apprentice: You[N]can pass when you solve[N]the mystery of the room[N]before you.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'av75_voice_doors'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_06D83E! `[TPL:8]Ishtar's voice echoes.[FIN][TPL:3][TPL:A]Don't be impatient like[N]that. Open them in order[N]from the left door.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'av75_voice_rooms'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_06DA14! `[TPL:8]Ishtar's voice echoes.[FIN][TPL:3][TPL:9]Carefully memorize the[N]state of that room.[FIN][TPL:A]When you think you have it[N]completely memorized you[N]may leave the room.[END]`

dialogstring_06DA6B! `[TPL:8]Ishtar's voice echoes.[FIN][TPL:3][TPL:A]Indicate the place that[N]differs from the previous[N]room before you.[END]`

dialogstring_06DAF0! `[TPL:3][TPL:8]That's correct!![FIN][TPL:A]You've noticed that the[N]jar's colour was[N]different, haven't you.[FIN]Very good. You may[N]advance to the next room.[END]`

dialogstring_06D87B! `[TPL:8]Ishtar's voice echoes.[FIN][TPL:3][TPL:A]That door has already been[N]opened. It isn't necessary[N]to open it again.[END]`

dialogstring_06DB2C! `[TPL:3][TPL:8]That's correct![FIN][TPL:9]Very good. You may advance[N]to the next room.[END]`

dialogstring_06DB4F! `[TPL:3][TPL:8]That's correct!![FIN][TPL:B]You've realized that the[N]treasure chest's contents[N]are different, haven't[N]you.[FIN]Very good.[N]You may advance to the[N]next room.[END]`

dialogstring_06DB9F! `[TPL:3][TPL:8]That's correct!![FIN][TPL:A]Your hair was fluttering[N]because the wind was[N]blowing, wasn't it.[FIN]You have passed my tests[N]splendidly. Alright, you[N]may return.[END]`

dialogstring_06CF5E! `[TPL:3][TPL:9]Ishtar: I had been[N]waiting for you to come.[FIN][TPL:B]You should sprinkle this[N]magic powder over the[N]picture of that girl, then[N]give it a heartfelt kiss.[FIN]Something should happen if[N]you truly feel for that[N]girl.[FIN][CLD][TPL:3][TPL:9]Well, you'll probably[N]understand eventually.[FIN]I painted my own[N]self-portrait.[FIN]I will soon be assimilated[N]into the picture…[FIN]That girl…[N]Protect her carefully…[END]`

dialogstring_06D039! `[TPL:3][TPL:8]…[END]`

;Found the magic powder!

;Magic powder / Magic powder which releases people who have been absorbed into a picture.

dialogstring_06D278! `[TPL:0][TPL:A][NAM:0]: I need to sprinkle[N]the magic powder to start[N]with…[END]`

----------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'chunk_038000'
----------------------------------

dialogstring_0393C5! `[TPL:D]Tried using the magic[N]powder.[FIN]`

dialogstring_0393EA! `But nothing happened![END]`

dialogstring_0393FA! `Sprinkled the magic powder[N]on the picture of [NAM:1]![END]`

dialogstring_06D2A4! `[TPL:0][TPL:E][NAM:0]: I'm begging you.[N][NAM:1]… Please return to[N]your original form…[FIN][CLD][TPL:D][NAM:0] placed a heartfelt[N]kiss on [NAM:1]'s picture…[END]`

dialogstring_06D339! `[TPL:1][TPL:9][NAM:1]: [NAM:0]… I'm sorry for[N]being selfish…[FIN]`

dialogstring_06D364! `[TPL:0][TPL:A][NAM:0]: Agh, you've been[N]terrible…! You've been[N]incredibly bad…!![FIN][TPL:B]Are you so irresponsible[N]that you're willing to[N]cause trouble for other[N]people…!?[FIN][CLD][TPL:1][TPL:8][NAM:1]: …[END]`

dialogstring_06D3CC! `[TPL:1][TPL:9][NAM:1]: Waaaaaaaaaaah![N]*Sob*… *Sniff*…[FIN][TPL:A]I… *Sob* I don't even[N]know… why I'm doing it[N]myself… *Sniff*…[FIN]The thing is, when I was[N]in the castle… I got[N]everything that I wanted…[FIN]But since I've been on[N]this journey, it's been[N]totally different…[FIN][CLD][TPL:0][TPL:8][NAM:0]: Isn't it obvious…!?[FIN][TPL:B]When you're only thinking[N]of yourself, you're in[N]trouble when things get[N]serious…!![FIN][CLD][TPL:1][TPL:8][NAM:1]: That's not it…![FIN][TPL:9]Even when you're far away,[N]I feel that you're close.[FIN][TPL:A]And even when you're close[N]to me I feel that you're[N]far away…[FIN]If you don't understand,[N]that's fine…[FIN][TPL:B]But I don't think I'll[N]forget what happened[N]today for the rest of my[N]life…[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'av6A_erik'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_06C568! `[TPL:6][TPL:9]Neil: [NAM:1]![N]I was worried…!![FIN][TPL:2][TPL:9][NAM:2]: Why do you always[N]run around by yourself…!?[FIN]Don't you have any concern[N]for anyone else…!?[FIN][TPL:1][TPL:A][NAM:1]: If you're talking[N]about that, [NAM:0] already[N]scolded me.[FIN]Because of that, I[N]sincerely apologize to[N]everyone…! *Bow*…[FIN][TPL:6][TPL:B]Neil: Well, it seems that[N]even the perpetrator[N]understands the matter,[N]so I can tolerate it.[FIN]Anyway, it seems that if[N]we proceed about three[N]days to the south, you get[N]to the Floating City.[FIN]I think we'll try to[N]leave right away. Talk to[N]me when you're prepared[N]to leave.[END]`

dialogstring_06C6A0! `[TPL:3][TPL:9][NAM:3]: Ah, speaking of[N]that…[FIN][TPL:B]In the fallen angels'[N]village, I noticed[N]something that looked[N]like a Red Jewel.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'av6A_lily'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_06C2F8! `[TPL:2][TPL:A][NAM:2]: [NAM:1] seems to be[N]strange somehow, doesn't[N]she…?[FIN]I have a sense about these[N]things; was something[N]wrong with [NAM:1]?[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'av6A_lance'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_06BFBE! `[TPL:4][TPL:B][NAM:4]: I suppose that[N][NAM:2]'s birthday will[N]come when we're in the[N]Floatin' City…[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'av6A_kara'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_06C417! `[TPL:1][TPL:12][NAM:1]: You know, they say[N]that there are a lot of[N]houses built on rafts in[N]the place that they call[N]the Floating City.[FIN][CLD][TPL:1][TPL:A]It's kind of romantic,[N]isn't it? I think it's[N]fun…[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'av6A_neil'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_06C10D! `[TPL:6][TPL:A]Neil: Is it okay to go?[N][PAL:0] Yes[N] Wait a bit[PAL:4]`

dialogstring_06C136! `[CLR]Neil: Don't rush things.[N]Take your time finishing[N]your business.[END]`

dialogstring_06C15C! `[CLR]Neil: It seems that the[N]Floating City is a[N]considerably hot place.[FIN]Everyone mustn't get[N]heatstroke, so take care.[END]`

;CHAPTER 24

;Fallen angels' town

;Floating City Watermia

;Floating City Watermia

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa78_intro'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_0780B6! `[TPL:0][TPL:F][DLY:2]We arrived at the[N]Floating City, Watermia.[N]It was a beautiful town[N]made up of rows of houses[N]that were built on rafts.[PAU:58][CLR]Since the townspeople are[N]nice too, we ended up[N]being given accommodations[N]in the house of a friendly[N]young man named Luke.[PAU:84][CLD]`

dialogstring_078139! `[TPL:0][TPL:F][DLY:0]And here is Luke's house.[N]He's a kind gentleman who[N]works as fisherman.[FIN][TPL:10]He was going out for a[N]long time on an ocean[N]voyage, so he said that we[N]should use his house in[N]the meantime.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa79_kara'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07A613! `[TPL:1][TPL:B][NAM:1]: Watermia is an[N]amazingly pretty town, but[N]I've heard some unpleasant[N]gossip…[FIN]Something like playing[N]with people's lives…[N]What was it…?[FIN]I wonder if without[N]exception, beautiful[N]things always have[N]another side.[FIN]It was like that with the[N]Capital of Flowers…[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa79_erik'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07A475! `[TPL:3][TPL:9][NAM:3]: Eheheh. I found[N]something good just now.[FIN][TPL:B]Take a look behind this[N]house. It might hurt your[N]conscience a little, but[N]hey…[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa79_lily'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07A92F! `[TPL:2][TPL:A][NAM:2]: Hey, by the way,[N][NAM:4] noticed someone he[N]knows in town.[FIN]And it looks like he went[N]looking for them.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa79_neil'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07A217! `[TPL:6][TPL:A]Neil: These houses on[N]rafts are inspiring me[N]for a new invention…[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa78_men'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07879B! `[TPL:1C][TPL:F]Luke: Yo. Are you taking[N]a liking to the house?[N]You're free to use it when[N]I go out on my voyage.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa78_diary'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_079C19! `[TPL:0][TPL:F][NAM:1] hid her diary here…[N]Read it?[N][PAL:0] Yes[N] No[PAL:4]`

dialogstring_079C4A! `[CLR]I guess that's how it is.[N]I'd feel guilty even if's[N]just selfishly reading it,[N]so I'll pass…[END]`

dialogstring_079C81! `[CLR][TPL:1][BOR:1][DLG:3,F][SIZ:D,5]Day X of month X:[N]It's been a long long[N]road, but we finally[N]arrived at the Capital of[N]Water, Watermia.[FIN][DLG:3,D][SIZ:D,6]I was thirsty along the[N]way, but I endured it. I[N]was developing blisters[N]inside my shoes, but I did[N]my best to bandage them[N]with a handkerchief.[FIN]Maybe I would have just[N]complained before, but I[N]didn't say anything now.[N]I think I've changed[N]dramatically with this[N]journey…[FIN]I've become used to[N]putting in my full effort[N]for the sake of a certain[N]someone. I'm taking a bit[N]of a liking to who I am[N]now.[FIN][CLD][TPL:1][BOR:1][TPL:F]I just heard from a[N]townsperson about a[N]legend that's spoken of[N]here.[FIN][DLG:3,F][SIZ:D,5]"If you make wish while[N]riding a lotus leaf on a[N]full moon night, the[N]person you like will take[N]a close look at you…ˮ[FIN][CLD][TPL:1][BOR:1][TPL:E]It's a wonderful legend,[N]isn't it? Can't I can try[N]it out soon…?[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa78_kruk'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_079AEF! `[TPL:C]Kyuui!!… Kyuui!!…[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa78_children'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_078CC5! `[TPL:1C][TPL:D]Savvas: My dad is an[N]explorer.[FIN][TPL:E]He's going to come back[N]to us soon, right after he[N]discovers the golden ship![END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa78_women'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_078A26! `[TPL:1C][TPL:10]Nana: We haven't heard[N]news from our dad even[N]though it's already been[N]half a year since we[N]received his last letter…[FIN][CLD][TPL:1C][TPL:D]It'll be fine so long as[N]he's safe, but…[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa78_crazy_man'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07A0A7! `[TPL:1C][TPL:E]An insane old man arrived[N]in this town two years[N]ago.[FIN][TPL:F]He's only blabbering[N]strange things about the[N]tower of Babel and stuff[N]like that since then.[END]`

dialogstring_078C59! `[TPL:1C][TPL:E]Child: A snake bit me when[N]I went to the Great Wall[N]of China before…[FIN][TPL:F]If the snakes around here[N]land their teeth on you[N]even once, they won't[N]easily let go.[END]`

dialogstring_078C12! `[TPL:1C][TPL:F]Child: If a snake bites[N]you, run in circles[N]randomly. If you do that[N]they'll plop off.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa78_centipede_man'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_0782BD! `[TPL:1C][TPL:F]Man: They say that a[N]giant centipede called[N]the Sand Fanger inhabits the[N]Great Wall of China.[FIN]It seems that its bodily[N]fluids have the power to[N]cure any kind of disease.[FIN][TPL:10]Chinese herbal medicine[N]uses a lot of weird things[N]as ingredients but I don't[N]think I'd just drink[N]insect lifeblood…[END]`

dialogstring_078D02! `[TPL:1C][TPL:D]Child: I'll teach you[N]something good.[FIN][TPL:F]Try waiting behind the[N]gambling house, on the[N]right side. A lotus leaf[N]will arrive.[END]`

dialogstring_078B73! `[TPL:1C][TPL:F]The so-called "crazy old[N]manˮ has amazingly white[N]hair but he is actually[N]still young.[FIN]I wonder if he saw[N]something that was[N]extremely frightening…[END]`

dialogstring_0788E0! `[TPL:1C][TPL:E]An old man who went[N]insane lives in a house[N]deep in this town.[FIN][TPL:10]I'm not sure, but I think[N]he participated in the[N]survey of the Tower of[N]Babel by the [NAM:9][N]expedition team.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa78_moving_woman'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07842C! `[TPL:1C][TPL:F]Woman: This is Watermia.[N]It's really easy to move[N]because everyone's houses[N]are on rafts.[END]`

dialogstring_078AF8! `[TPL:1C][TPL:D]Woman: I'm going to have[N]a baby soon.[FIN][TPL:F]My husband ended up[N]looking forward to it, so[N]he's diligently working[N]away to support us.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa7D_glass_opponent'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_078E01! `[TPL:24][TPL:A]Man: *cough* *cough*[N]Wh-what? I've only caught[N]a little cold.[END]`

dialogstring_0785C9! `[TPL:1C][TPL:F]Man: This is Watermia.[N]It's easy to move because[N]everyone's houses are on[N]rafts.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa78_water_kid'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_0784CF! `[TPL:1C][TPL:F]Child: We drink this[N]water, we cook our rice in[N]this water, we wash our[N]clothes with this water.[END]`

dialogstring_0789C7! `[TPL:1C][TPL:F]Water doesn't remain in[N]one place. It beautifully[N]moves itself without[N]pause.[FIN]We want to live like[N]water too, you know…?[END]`

dialogstring_07876E! `[TPL:1C][TPL:E]This lotus leaf is over[N]capacity. Get another if[N]you want to ride one.[END]`

dialogstring_078607! `[TPL:1C][TPL:D]Man: This animal is[N]called a [NAM:15].[FIN][TPL:10]It's perfect for crossing[N]the desert because it can[N]survive for a long time[N]without drinking or[N]eating.[END]`

dialogstring_078674! `[TPL:1C][TPL:D]Man: This is a gambling[N]house.[FIN][TPL:10]I guess you must be really[N]desperate for money if[N]you're coming to a place[N]like this even though[N]you're a child…[END]`

dialogstring_078ABA! `[TPL:1C][TPL:A]As you can see, this is a[N]drinking contest. We're[N]betting on who will win.[END]`

dialogstring_078881! `[TPL:1C][TPL:9]It's just like gambling[N]with human life.[FIN][TPL:12]If they make a little[N]mistake in their[N]judgement, they're sent[N]headfirst down the road[N]to hell.[FIN][CLD][TPL:1C][TPL:B]It's something that[N]humans do within their[N]unconscious mind, isn't[N]it?[END]`

dialogstring_078A73! `[TPL:1C][TPL:D]Human life isn't[N]something easy.[FIN][TPL:E]Make sure not to throw[N]your life away with[N]worthless gambling.[END]`

dialogstring_0787DA! `[TPL:1C][TPL:F]You can try going to the[N]raft floating behind this[N]building if you want to[N]make big money.[END]`

dialogstring_07881B! `[TPL:1C][TPL:A]You can get a lot of[N]money even if you only[N]bet a little.[FIN]I guess if you're willing[N]to bet your life, you can[N]get fabulously rich.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa7B_competitor_right'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07A188! `[TPL:1C][TPL:8]Ugh, ugh…[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa7B_competitor_left'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07A132! `[TPL:1C][TPL:9]Raaaaaagh…![N]I can still keep going…!![END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa7A_lances_father'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07B3C2! `[TPL:3][TPL:B][NAM:4]'s father: Hey, didja[N]know? I just went[N]exploring with my friends.[N]It was scary, but fuuun![END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa7A_lance'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07AB82! `[TPL:4][TPL:9][NAM:4]: [NAM:0]… Don't ya[N]remember this guy…?[FIN]That's right, it's my old[N]man.[END]`

dialogstring_07ABC4! `[TPL:4][TPL:9][NAM:4]: It looks like he[N]may have injured his head…[FIN][TPL:B]I was thinkin' that I had[N]finally met my missing old[N]man, but I guess this is[N]how it is…[END]`

dialogstring_07AC08! `[TPL:4][TPL:9][NAM:4]: [NAM:0], wait. I'm[N]going too.[FIN][TPL:B]It's [NAM:2]'s birthday[N]party after this, ain't[N]it. We can't be gloomy[N]today.[FIN]Alright, let's head back[N]ta our room.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa79_lance'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07AD31! `[TPL:4][TPL:B][NAM:4]: Alright, with[N]everyone present, let's[N]try ta celebrate [NAM:2]'s[N]birthday.[END]`

dialogstring_07A974! `[TPL:2][TPL:A][NAM:2]: Wha…? Wha…?[N]Everyone remembered my[N]birthday…?[FIN][TPL:3][TPL:A][NAM:3]: Isn't it obvious?[FIN]We thought we'd surprise[N]you so we kept it a[N]secret.[FIN][TPL:6][TPL:A]Neil: Hey [NAM:1].[N]Bring that out now.[END]`

dialogstring_07A6AF! `[TPL:1][TPL:9][NAM:1]: Got it…[N]It's a birthday cake![FIN]Neil made it.[FIN][TPL:6][TPL:9]Neil: Hahaha. It's my[N]first time making a cake.[FIN]It was definitely harder[N]than making an aeroplane.[FIN][TPL:2][TPL:9][NAM:2]: Thank you…[N]Everyone…[FIN][TPL:A]Today, I might be the[N]happiest girl in the[N]world.[FIN][TPL:0][TPL:A]This is how [NAM:2]'s[N]modest birthday party[N]began.[FIN]Then, when the party was[N]nearly over…[END]`

dialogstring_07AD63! `[TPL:4][TPL:A][NAM:4]: [NAM:2], hey. I have[N]a little somethin' ta say[N]ta ya; is that okay?[FIN]I'll be waitin' outside.[END]`

dialogstring_07A9F2! `[TPL:2][TPL:9][NAM:2]: Huh? What in the[N]world is that about…?[END]`

dialogstring_07AA09! `[TPL:2][TPL:9][NAM:2]: Sorry.[N]I'll head out for a bit.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa7F_lily'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07B277! `[TPL:2][TPL:C][NAM:2]: What is it?[FIN][TPL:E]You don't seem like your[N]usual self. You're acting[N]humble somehow.[FIN][TPL:4][TPL:E][NAM:4]: I guess that's[N]true. I don't seem like[N]myself ta me, either.[FIN][TPL:F]Here's a birthday present.[N]I thought o' various[N]things, but I think this[N]yer favourite, ain't it?[END]`

dialogstring_07B2E4! `[TPL:2][TPL:E][NAM:2]: Wow! This is[N]amaaazing! It's a bouquet[N]of roses…![FIN]Rosebuds… These will bloom[N]into flowers, won't they?[END]`

dialogstring_07B329! `[TPL:2][TPL:D][NAM:2]: They have a[N]wonderful aroma…[FIN]Thank you.[N]I'm aaamazingly happy…[FIN][TPL:4][TPL:F][NAM:4]: Also… There are[N]words I want ta convey ta[N]ya together with tha[N]present, any way I can.[FIN][TPL:2][TPL:F][NAM:2]: What?[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa7F_lance'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07B0A2! `[TPL:4][TPL:F][NAM:4]: Yeah. Tha words are[N]much more difficult than[N]tongue twisters and stuff[N]like that, but…[END]`

dialogstring_07B0E1! `[TPL:4][TPL:D][DLY:2][NAM:4]: [NAM:2]…[N]I care about ya a lot…[END]`

dialogstring_07B108! `[TPL:4][TPL:D][DLY:2][NAM:4]: It's okay if ya[N]don't reply immediately…[FIN]But I wanted ta convey[N]my own feelings ta ya…[END]`

dialogstring_07B158! `[TPL:4][TPL:9][NAM:4]: [NAM:2]![N]Please wait…!![PAU:50][CLD]`

dialogstring_07B174! `[TPL:0][TPL:A][NAM:0]: We didn't know that[N]an incident like that had[N]happened at all.[FIN][NAM:2] didn't come back to[N]our room that day…[END]`

dialogstring_07A79C! `[TPL:0][TPL:9][NAM:0]: Then, the following[N]morning…[FIN]When my eyes opened, there[N]was no sign of [NAM:4]…[END]`

dialogstring_07A7E2! `[TPL:1][TPL:A][NAM:1]: I wonder what[N]happened to [NAM:4] and[N][NAM:2]. I'm worried…[END]`

;Rob's letter / A letter from Rob addressed to Tim.

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'chunk_038000'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_039514! `[TPL:C]Opened [NAM:4]'s letter.[FIN][TPL:4][BOR:1][TPL:E][NAM:4]: I'm going ta tha[N]Great Wall o' China fer a[N]little bit.[FIN][TPL:F]I had intended ta keep[N]this a secret from[N]everyone, but I thought[N]I'd only tell you…[FIN]I'll put this letter in[N]yer luggage, but I wonder[N]if you'll notice. I think[N]yer pretty dumb after all.[FIN]I learned a method ta cure[N]my old man's disease from[N]tha townspeople's stories…[FIN]It seems like that[N]medicine is at tha Great[N]Wall o' China.[FIN]Tha path is long, but I'll[N]just run it like a[N]marathon and be right[N]back. Don't worry.[FIN]P.S.: Ah, that's right,[N]I nearly forgot… [NAM:2][N]ended up turnin' me down.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa78_glass_game'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07927C! `[TPL:1C][TPL:E]Every month on a full moon[N]night, people play Russian[N]glass.[FIN]It's the ultimate form of[N]gambling where you bet[N]your very life.[FIN][TPL:F]But you're still young,[N]little boy. I definitely[N]don't think you should be[N]throwing your life away.[END]`

dialogstring_08E428! `[PRT:@dialogstring_08DE96][NAM:0]'s power Spin Dash can[N]jump to ascend slopes that[N]are too sleep to climb.[FIN]There are many hills here[N]in the Great Wall of[N]China. Try attempting it[N]in various places.[FIN][RET]`

dialogstring_08ECEA! `Spin Dash is a power that[N]only [NAM:0], the boy, can[N]use.[FIN]Thine own high-speed[N]rotation can send enemies[N]flying. Thou can run up[N]hills that use recoil.[FIN]Thou shouldst alternate[N]between L and R while[N]holding the attack button…`

dialogstring_07B8AD! `[TPL:4][TPL:9][NAM:4]: Ah, those stones[N]are…[FIN][TPL:0][TPL:9][NAM:0]: We arrived here when[N]we followed these pebbles.[FIN]I'll return the stones to[N]you. Here you go…[WAI][CLD][PAU:3C][::][TPL:4][TPL:8][SFX:0][DLY:2][NAM:4] whispered…[FIN][TPL:A][NAM:4]: [NAM:0]…won't ya leave[N]me with [NAM:2] fer just a[N]little bit?[END]`

dialogstring_07B960! `[TPL:4][TPL:9][DLY:2][NAM:4]: I was saved with[N]tha help o' these stones…[FIN]Tha truth is,[N]I made this fer ya…[END]`

dialogstring_07B9B1! `[TPL:4][TPL:B][NAM:4]: Tha stones in tha[N]necklace ended up bein'[N]awfully small, but won't[N]ya take it fer me?[FIN][CLD][TPL:A][SFX:0][DLY:2][NAM:4] gently affixed the[N]necklace onto [NAM:2]'s[N]neck.[END]`

dialogstring_07BBB0! `[TPL:4][TPL:8][DLY:0][NAM:4]: Ah…[WAI][CLD][PAU:40][TPL:2][TPL:9][DLY:2][NAM:2]: I won't run away[N]this time…[FIN][TPL:B]Last time, I wasn't[N]expecting what you did. I[N]was surprised and didn't[N]know what I should do…[FIN]But right now, I just[N]don't want you to be able[N]to see my face.[FIN]I'm so happy that my[N]tears are flooding out…[END]`

dialogstring_07BC42! `[TPL:2][TPL:B][DLY:2][NAM:2]: [NAM:4]…from the time[N]when we first met, I felt[N]something that was[N]different about you…[FIN][CLD][TPL:2][TPL:A][DLY:2]But now I have a feeling[N]that I understand what[N]that something is…[FIN]The reply I had for you[N]back then… The reply that[N]I wanted to give you…[END]`

dialogstring_07BCAA! `[TPL:2][TPL:9][NAM:2]:[N][DLY:3]I care about you, too…[FIN][TPL:A][DLY:2]It would be nice if we[N]could always be together,[N]wouldn't it…?[END]`

dialogstring_07BA2E! `[TPL:4][TPL:A][DLY:0][NAM:4]: Yahoo!![DLY:1] This is tha[N]first time I've ever felt[N]like this…!![FIN]I'm almost a million times[N]as happy as I am at the[N]start of summer vacation…![FIN][TPL:2][TPL:A][DLY:1][NAM:2]: Tee hee…[N]I feel the saaame way.[FIN]Alright, let's return to[N]town. Everyone must be[N]worried.[END]`

dialogstring_0796A9! `[TPL:1C][TPL:F]This is where we meet for[N]Russian glass.[N]Are you participating?[WAI][N][PAL:0] Yes[N] No[PAL:4]`

dialogstring_0796DE! `[CLR]Alright, in that case, go[N]home. Then forget[N]everything you saw here.[END]`

dialogstring_079704! `[CLR]What, you're betting your[N]young life on Russian[N]glass…?![FIN]This isn't a game.[N]You're betting your life.[FIN]I'll ask you one more[N]time. You really won't[N]regret this?[WAI][N][PAL:0] Yes[N] No[PAL:4]`

dialogstring_07977A! `[CLR]Very well. The one[N]standing there is the[N]opponent you're competing[N]against.[FIN]He's a veteran of this[N]game. I've never seen a[N]human being with luck[N]like his.[FIN]Alright. You may ask him[N]about the rules.[END]`

dialogstring_0797E6! `[TPL:1C][TPL:D]Another young life will be[N]reduced to ashes tonight…[END]`

dialogstring_079610! `[TPL:1C][TPL:E]There is no other game as[N]exciting as this. I'm[N]shaking.[END]`

dialogstring_0795B9! `[TPL:1C][TPL:E]How can you bet your life[N]like this? You're still[N]young.[END]`

dialogstring_079835! `[TPL:1C][TPL:D]You have courage, don't[N]you?[END]`

dialogstring_07986C! `[TPL:1C][TPL:F]It seems that your[N]opponent has earned a lot[N]of money through this[N]game.[FIN]I wonder what in the[N]world he's using it for…[END]`

dialogstring_0792F7! `[TPL:24][TPL:F]Competitor: Humph… You[N]haven't even experienced[N]life yet, and you still[N]dare to come here?[FIN]The rules are simple. One[N]of these five glasses has[N]poison placed into it.[FIN]We take turns drinking[N]them. Whoever is left[N]alive in the end is the[N]winner.[FIN]Well, I'll start…![END]`

dialogstring_0793B6! `[TPL:24][TPL:D]Competitor:[N]Raaaaaaaaagh…!![FIN][CLD][TPL:E][SFX:0]The competitor drained the[N]contents of the glass in[N]one gulp…[END]`

dialogstring_079922! `[TPL:0][TPL:E][NAM:0]: Oh? The drink in the[N]glass looks as though it's[N]dyed with blood…[FIN]Is this because of the[N]power that is dwelling[N]inside my body too…?[FIN][TPL:F]Drink the contents of the[N]glass?[N][PAL:0] Yes[N] No[PAL:4]`

dialogstring_079992! `[CLR][NAM:0]: I'll skip this[N]glass…[END]`

dialogstring_07944D! `[TPL:24][TPL:D]Competitor: This is the[N]one remaining glass…[WAI][CLD][PAU:3C][TPL:1C][TPL:D][DLY:2]Spectator: It's okay now…[N]This boy won…[FIN][DLY:0]Spectator: That's right![N]Stop it already…!![FIN][TPL:24][TPL:F][DLY:3]Contestant: No…[PAU:1E] I have no[N]intention of being left in[N]shame with my tail between[N]my legs…[FIN][CLD][TPL:D][SFX:0][DLY:2]The man took the glass in[N]hand…[END]`

dialogstring_079520! `[TPL:1C][TPL:E]Spectator: Put that down[N]and come over here…! It's[N]already your loss…!![FIN]You don't need to be in a[N]hurry to die…![FIN][CLD][TPL:F][SFX:0][DLY:3]The man, not listening to[N]the spectators, quickly[N]downed the contents of the[N]glass![END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa7D_glass_opponent'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_078E2D! `[TPL:1C][TPL:F]Woman: You must be the[N]gentleman who was[N]competing in Russian[N]glass, right?[FIN]My husband said that he[N]had found a good job[N]so I shouldn't worry;[FIN]I never expected that it[N]would be something like[N]that…[FIN]This is my husband's will.[N]"To my opponentˮ is[N]written on the cover.[N]Please read it.[FIN]With that, there are four[N][NAM:15]s outside of my[N]house; please use them.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa78_women'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_078B3B! `[TPL:1C][TPL:D]Woman: We don't need money[N]at all…[FIN][TPL:F]But they say that true[N]luck is being together[N]someone you care about,[N]don't they?[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'chunk_038000'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_039696! `[TPL:D]Gently opened and read[N]the will.[FIN][TPL:24][BOR:1][TPL:E] [N]      To my Opponent[N] [FIN][DLG:3,B][SIZ:D,7]Even when I've died, I[N]want you not to mourn. And[N]I want you to not feel[N]down. I was knocking on[N]heaven's door even if it[N]wasn't Russian glass that[N]killed me.[FIN]When I was diagnosed with[N]an incurable illness half[N]a year ago, I was thinking[N]that I should put all of[N]my effort into earning[N]money until death comes[N]for me.[FIN]I thought that I shouldn't[N]cause problems for my wife[N]and still unseen child[N]after my death, after all.[N]However, the money I[N]earned brought unhappiness[N]to others.[FIN]I think I'll end it this[N]time… If I am defeated in[N]this match, I want to[N]share some of my property[N]with you that has bravery.[N]Please adore my four[N]favourite [NAM:15]s.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa78_prize_kruk'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_079B30! `[TPL:0][TPL:E]I guess these are the[N][NAM:15]s that they said they[N]were giving me…[FIN]I have to inform everyone[N]right away.[END]`

dialogstring_07A833! `[TPL:1][TPL:A][NAM:1]: They say Neil[N]wasn't born in any old[N]house.[FIN]His family runs a trading[N]company from their mansion[N]in the town of Euro.[END]`

dialogstring_07A506! `[TPL:3][TPL:A][NAM:3]: Why do we have to[N]part with [NAM:4] and [NAM:2][N]now…?[END]`

dialogstring_07ADEA! `[TPL:4][TPL:A][NAM:4]: It's my bad fer[N]everything, but I'm[N]remainin' here.[FIN]I guess I can't just dump[N]that old man of mine.[FIN]After that… [PAU:78]Uh, I guess[N]I'm feelin' shy or[N]somethin'…[FIN]The thing is, I'm goin'[N]out with [NAM:2].[FIN][TPL:B]These feelin's ain't fer[N]play, of course. I want us[N]ta be together fer a[N]while.[FIN]And [NAM:2] says that she[N]wants ta stay together[N]too.[FIN]It was fun goin' out on a[N]journey with everyone. I[N]pray that yer journey is[N]successful.[END]`

dialogstring_07AA5E! `[TPL:2][TPL:9][NAM:2]: I'm also remaining[N]in this town.[FIN]As for the reason…[N]Well, ask [NAM:4].[END]`

dialogstring_07A2BE! `[TPL:6][TPL:A]Neil: You're saying you[N]were given [NAM:15]s!? That[N]kind of expensive thing…?[FIN]Why are you looking at me[N]with those sort of[N]lonely-seeming eyes…?[FIN]Well, I won't dig deeply[N]into the reason.[FIN][TPL:B]With that being said. I[N]thought we'd end up going[N]to the town called Euro to[N]the west, but…[FIN][NAM:4] and [NAM:2] say[N]they're staying in this[N]town. Well, listen to the[N]reason from those two.[END]`

dialogstring_07A366! `[TPL:6][TPL:12]Neil: I think that the[N]moment where a boy and a[N]girl develop feelings for[N]each other is wonderful[N]and magical.[FIN][CLD][TPL:6][TPL:A]I want to believe that[N]we'll never forget this[N]feeling.[FIN]Anyway. My parents' house[N]is in Euro, isn't it?[FIN]I think we'll familiarize[N]ourselves with [NAM:0]'s power[N]somehow if we go there.[FIN]Alright, let's head out to[N]Euro…!![END]`

dialogstring_07BEDA! `[TPL:0][TPL:F][SFX:10][DLY:1]The desert was howling[N]with sandstorms. We[N]crossed it, ending up at[N]Euro.[PAU:60][CLR]Euro was a metropolis[N]greater than anything I[N]could imagine. Busy[N]looking people were[N]running around everywhere.[PAU:7C][CLR]Neil's parents live in[N]this town, running the[N]Reuleck Corporation.[PAU:60][CLR]Neil was returning home[N]after three years.[PAU:60][CLR]After his parents welcomed[N]us, they showed us[N]something awe-worthy…[PAU:60][CLR]Fireworks launching! Line[N]dancers appearing![PAU:60][CLR]I felt like the town had[N]just erupted into a whole[N]festival.[PAU:60][CLD]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'eu96_neil'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07DBE9! `[TPL:6][TPL:A]Neil: Well, while you're[N]in this room, please take[N]it easy.[FIN][TPL:B]I'll talk to my parents[N]for a little bit. It's[N]already been three years,[N]hasn't it?[END]`

-------------------------------------

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'eu96_kara'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07DA00! `[TPL:1][TPL:9][NAM:1]: It's an amaaazing[N]house, isn't it…?[FIN][TPL:B]I suppose that there are[N]citizens that have more[N]money than kings as of[N]late…[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'eu95_ann'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07DF7A! `[TPL:1][BOR:D][TPL:A]Ann: So, a man wearing a[N]dark blue mantle came here[N]a few days ago.[FIN]He was asking if a girl[N]named [NAM:1] had come[N]to this city.[FIN]I cowered from the way he[N]glared with his icy eyes.[FIN][TPL:B]It might be good to tell[N]this to [NAM:1], but…[N][PAL:0] If that's what you want![N] Please don't, I beg you![PAL:4]`

dialogstring_07E03D! `[CLR]I can't stomach how that[N][NAM:1] girl acts like such[N]a little lady.[FIN]If that's what you're[N]going to say, I think I'll[N]bully you a little.[END]`

dialogstring_07E092! `[CLR]Hehehe. I've gotten a hold[N]of your weak point.[FIN][::]Aah. I think I want to eat[N]some apples. Go buy them[N]from the market for me![END]`

dialogstring_07E0DE! `[TPL:1][BOR:D][TPL:A][JMP:&dialogstring_07E092+M]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'eu95_neils_mother'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07E31B! `[TPL:1E][TPL:12]Neil's mother: Since we[N]already earn a lot of[N]money, we want you to be[N]able to just have fun for[N]the rest of your life.[FIN][CLD][TPL:1E][TPL:8]Won't you succeed us…?[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'eu95_neil'
-------------------------------------

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'eu91_men2'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07C9DB! `[TPL:1E][TPL:10]This is the mansion where[N]the married couple that[N]serve as the presidents of[N]the Reuleck Corporation[N]live.[END]`

dialogstring_07C970! `[TPL:1E][TPL:10]A man named [NAM:16][N]or something like that[N]popped up some days ago[N]and went around asking[N]various questions.[FIN]From the look in his eyes,[N]he's got to be an[N]assassin. He could be[N]after someone, but I have[N]no idea who.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'eu91_women2'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07CAB0! `[TPL:1E][TPL:D]There are a lot of narrow[N]back alleys in this town.[FIN][TPL:E]You can even enter into[N]the crevices between[N]houses.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'eu91_book'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07E4D3! `[TPL:1E][TPL:F]It's a book by a person[N]named Rofski. It holds[N]predictions about the[N]future of humanity.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'eu91_merchant'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07C337! `[TPL:1E][TPL:F]Hey, hey, you mustn't come[N]on this side. Customers[N]should go to the[N]opposite side…![END]`
dialogstring_07C38F! `[TPL:1E][TPL:F]Hey, hey, you mustn't come[N]on this side. Customers[N]should go to the[N]opposite side…![END]`

dialogstring_07C1DC! `[TPL:1E][TPL:E]This is a Tearpot. Quite[N]simply, it's a pot for[N]holding tears.[FIN]You know, this town was[N]once dragged into war.[FIN][DLG:3,D][SIZ:D,6]There's an anecdote that[N]women collected their[N]tears in these pots while[N]they waited for their[N]husbands to return from[N]the war.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'eu91_women1'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07C836! `[TPL:1E][TPL:F]Do you believe in[N]fortune-telling?[N][PAL:0] Yes[N] No[PAL:4]`

dialogstring_07C860! `[CLR]That's how it is, is it?[N]So you're saying that if[N]you have your future told,[N]it might be a dark future…[FIN]An extremely huge comet[N]is grazing across the[N]Earth… They say that[N]people will die off…[FIN]Well, if that's how it is,[N]all I'm going to do from[N]now on is binge eat…!![END]`

dialogstring_07C8D5! `[CLR]That's good, isn't it?[N]Me, I'll believe anything…[END]`

dialogstring_07C182! `[TPL:1E][TPL:E]This is a fish market. We[N]sell fish that's arrived[N]fresh from Watermia.[END]`

dialogstring_07C3D4! `[TPL:1E][TPL:E]I can't do business when[N]the customer is on my[N]side of the counter.[END]`

dialogstring_07C1B6! `[TPL:1E][TPL:E]This is cornmeal. You can[N]use it when making[N]cornbread.[END]`

dialogstring_07C160! `[TPL:1E][TPL:F]This is wine. It might be[N]a little too soon for a[N]little boy like to you[N]have, I'd think.[END]`

dialogstring_07CB60! `[DEF]I saw that. There are[N]many people confined[N]under the school.[END]`
;UNUSED!!

dialogstring_07CAE0! `[TPL:1E][TPL:E]I saw… A lot of people[N]imprisoned in the basement[N]of the chapel…[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'eu91_men1'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07C509! `[TPL:1E][TPL:E]This town flourishes by[N]the grace of the Reuleck[N]Corporation.[FIN][TPL:F]There are more than enough[N]bad rumours about them,[N]too, but I still think the[N]company is amazing.[END]`

dialogstring_07C0F3! `[TPL:1E][TPL:F]You're looking at me like[N]you want something… I[N]understand. I'll give you[N]one of these apples.[FIN][NAM:0] received an apple![END]`

dialogstring_07C0DD! `[TPL:1E][TPL:D]How about a sweet and[N]delicious apple?[END]`

;Bright red apple / An apple received in Euro's market.

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'chunk_038000'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_039F6B! `[TPL:10]You felt a tiny bit[N]relaxed when you filled[N]your mouth with the bright[N]red apple. It was a[N]tasty apple.[END]`

dialogstring_07C8EC! `[TPL:1E][TPL:E]They say that there are[N]people in this town who[N]make it powerful.[END]`

dialogstring_07C142! `[TPL:1E][TPL:D]Our fruits are soft and[N]yummy.[END]`

dialogstring_07C4D0! `[TPL:1E][TPL:E]This is the market. You[N]might discover rare goods[N]here.[END]`

dialogstring_07C5AB! `[TPL:1E][TPL:D]This is an office of the[N]Reuleck Corporation.[FIN][TPL:E]Most of the goods being[N]sold in this town are[N]stocked by that company.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'eu94_employee'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07CF75! `[TPL:0][TPL:9][SFX:0]It seems like they're[N]talking about work…[FIN][TPL:1E][TPL:B]Man: I hear that your[N]company trades in all[N]kinds of things…[N]I'm listening, but…[FIN][TPL:4][BOR:D][TPL:B]Company person: Yeah. We[N]do everything. From tea[N]and fruit through to[N]animal pelts…[FIN]Don't say it openly, but[N]we also deal in labour,[N]even in women…[END]`

dialogstring_07C60A! `[TPL:1E][TPL:B]Man: Nahhh, if this[N]company deals with[N]everything, they've really[N]saved me.[END]`

dialogstring_07CF1F! `[TPL:4][BOR:D][TPL:9]Company person: U-umm…[N]What's with this kid…?[FIN][TPL:B]Some middle-aged guys are[N]talking about work, so[N]please go play outside or[N]something![END]`

dialogstring_07CB09! `[TPL:1E][TPL:A]There's a lot of baggage[N]piled up next to the[N]company, right?[FIN]Sometimes when the baggage[N]is being carried, you can[N]hear groaning from inside.[FIN]I somehow have a bad[N]feeling about it…[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'eu9A_max'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07E6AD! `[TPL:1E][TPL:A]Max: I'm crazy about[N]joining an expedition to[N]some other land this time…[FIN]But I'm worried because[N]the team leader's so[N]temperamental. Ugh…[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'eu9A_friezer'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07E61D! `[TPL:1E][TPL:9]Friesel: I am Friesel,[N]the explorer.[FIN][TPL:12]I want history to remember[N]my name, just like when[N]the now-famous [NAM:9][N]discovered the Tower of[N]Babel.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'eu9A_rudy'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07E72A! `[TPL:1E][TPL:B]Rudy: The truth is, we[N]still have a lot of[N]questions about what we[N]call the ruins.[FIN]So we've set our hearts on[N]going out on a great[N]journey.[END]`

dialogstring_07C6FE! `[TPL:1E][TPL:B]If I remember correctly,[N]you could find the[N]droplets from mushrooms[N]all over the holy grounds…[FIN]Aah, I didn't mean to talk[N]about grown-up things so[N]quickly.[END]`

dialogstring_07C63F! `[TPL:1E][TPL:A]I went with my brother to[N]play on Mount Kehres when[N]I was little.[FIN]We went to the place that[N]they call the holy grounds[N]and got lost.[FIN][TPL:B]If I remember correctly,[N]there were giant mushrooms[N]and plant stalks sprouting[N]as if they were a maze.[FIN][TPL:12]If the droplets from a[N]mushroom are poured onto[N]the end of a stalk, it[N]will suddenly spring to[N]life and grow a path.[FIN][CLD][TPL:1E][TPL:9]Everyone else vividly[N]remembers it too.[END]`

dialogstring_07C4AA! `[TPL:1E][TPL:F]The residential area is[N]ahead of here. You can't[N]enter unless you're a[N]townsperson.[END]`

dialogstring_07C7BA! `[TPL:1E][TPL:F]The world-famous literati[N]Rofski and the violinist[N]Elazquez live in this[N]house.[FIN]But the two are constantly[N]quibbling. A lot of[N]geniuses are hard to[N]please, aren't they?[END]`

dialogstring_07C480! `[TPL:1E][TPL:E]This is Euro. A lot of the[N]population are merchants[N]in this town.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa79_lily'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07AAA3! `[TPL:2][TPL:12][NAM:2]: There's a rumour[N]flying around that a big[N]star is going to collide[N]with the Earth or[N]something like that.[FIN][CLD][TPL:2][TPL:A]I'm definitely not going[N]to believe that kind of[N]gossip.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa79_lance'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07AEDE! `[TPL:4][TPL:A][NAM:4]: It seems like my[N]old man is gettin' better[N]day by day…[FIN][TPL:B]It seems like he's able ta[N]talk normally now.[FIN]I think it would be nice[N]if ya could also meet yer[N]old man soon.[FIN]Oh, that's right. If I[N]remember, I think ya were[N]collectin' Red Jewels.[FIN][TPL:B]I found a Red Jewel from[N]inside my old man's[N]possessions. Take it[N]along.[FIN][CLD][TPL:8][NAM:0] received a Red Jewel![END]`

dialogstring_07AFA7! `[TPL:4][TPL:A][NAM:4]: If would be nice if[N]ya could also meet yer old[N]man soon.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'wa7A_lances_father'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07B412! `[TPL:3][TPL:B][NAM:4]'s father: Oh…[N][NAM:0], isn't it? I'm sorry;[N]I guess I must have[N]worried you.[FIN][NAM:4] and [NAM:2] really did[N]all they could to nurse me[N]back to health…[FIN]I used to think that I[N]didn't want a child to[N]dominate my life.[FIN][TPL:12]But now that things have[N]turned out like this, I[N]can see that it's nice to[N]have a child that's loyal[N]to you.[END]`

dialogstring_07C9FF! `[TPL:1E][TPL:E]The Reuleck Corporation[N]has even caused this town[N]to change terribly.[FIN]It's become a base for[N]merchants due to the[N]company's global growth.[FIN]There's always something[N]hiding behind a growing[N]company, isn't there?[END]`

-------------------------------------

?INCLUDE 'eu97_clerk1'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07CC0A! `[TPL:1E][TPL:A]Employee: Dear customer…![N]This is the exit. Please[N]head to the entrance![END]`

dialogstring_07D423! `[TPL:1E][TPL:E]How many times have I[N]lined up for things like[N]this already?[END]`

dialogstring_07D43E! `[TPL:1E][TPL:E]There's a lot of joy to be[N]found through hardship,[N]isn't there?[END]`

dialogstring_07D3F6! `[TPL:1E][TPL:E]Humanity is seeing a queue[N]and wanting to join it for[N]some reason, right?[END]`
;TODO!!

dialogstring_07D479! `[TPL:1E][TPL:E]Humanity is seeing a queue[N]and wanting to join it for[N]some reason, right?[END]`

dialogstring_07D4A9! `[TPL:1E][TPL:F]There's a thing being sold[N]in this store called the[N]Medicine of Life or[N]something like that.[FIN]I don't know if it's[N]really effective or what,[N]but I want to live for a[N]long time, so here I am.[END]`

-------------------------------------

-------------------------------------

dialogstring_07CBE3! `[TPL:1E][TPL:A]Employee: Are you[N]returning home? Thank you[N]very much.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'eu97_dark_medicine'

dialogstring_07CE54! `[CLR][TPL:0][TPL:F]It had a scent that[N]irritated your nose…[FIN]However, it seems that[N][NAM:11]'s Power of[N]Darkness grew stronger.[FIN][CLD][TPL:C]Dark [NAM:10]'s power rose!![END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'eu97_life_medicine'

dialogstring_07CD64! `[CLR][TPL:0][TPL:F]The taste irritated your[N]mouth… However, your[N]endurance rose!![END]`

dialogstring_07CDB3! `[TPL:1E][TPL:D]I'm sorry… There is a[N]limit of one per person.[END]`

dialogstring_07C56C! `[TPL:1E][TPL:C]This is the chapel.[FIN][TPL:F]The presidents of the[N]company are devoutly[N]faithful people, so they[N]often come here.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'eu9D_altar'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07E5BE! `[TPL:0][TPL:E][NAM:0]: Oh? It seems that[N]wind is blowing in from[N]behind the Madonna…[FIN]Try examining it?[N][PAL:0] Yes[N] No`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'eu9D_slaves'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07D207! `[TPL:16][TPL:F]I understand a little of[N]your language. We were[N]brought here from a[N]distant place…[END]`

dialogstring_07D1D3! `[TPL:16][TPL:F]We are forced to learn the[N]language here, and then[N]are sold off to separate[N]places…[END]`

dialogstring_07D196! `[TPL:16][TPL:F]The bones scattered over[N]there were our companions…[N]If we don't obey an order,[N]that's how it ends for us.[END]`

dialogstring_07D167! `[TPL:16][TPL:F]I want to talk in the[N]language of my motherland…[N]But I'll be beaten if I do[N]that…[END]`

dialogstring_07D0DC! `[TPL:16][TPL:E]Recently, various diseases[N]have broken out in our[N]homeland…[FIN]There is even an awful[N]disease where the body is[N]turned into stone…[FIN]So I'm escaping to another[N]country, even if it means[N]becoming a slave…[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'eu92_rofsky'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07D6C2! `[TPL:9][SFX:10]Two elderly people are[N]arguing about something…[WAI][CLD][PAU:1E][TPL:3][TPL:9]Rofski: What sort of[N]genius violinist are you?[FIN][TPL:A]You're at your best when[N]you take your bow and get[N]off the stage!![FIN][TPL:4][TPL:A]Elazquez: Hmph! I guess[N]two-bit writers always[N]talk big…!![END]`

dialogstring_07D61E! `[TPL:3][TPL:B]Rofski: We started arguing[N]because of the Tearpot[N]enshrined in the holy[N]grounds of Mount Kehres.[FIN]I believe that the tears[N]shed by the gods were[N]once enshrined at Mount[N]Kehres.[FIN]There's a legend that says[N]they will save mankind.[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'eu92_erasquez'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07D7C7! `[TPL:4][TPL:A]Elazquez: You there… I[N]feel from thee a[N]mysterious power…[FIN][TPL:12]I'm already blind, but[N]since I've lost my sight,[N]I've developed a keen[N]sense for things that are[N]clearly special.[FIN]This is perfect. Will you[N]go to the holy grounds of[N]Mount Kehres and see the[N]state of the Tearpot for[N]me?[FIN][CLD][SFX:10][TPL:A]Rofski drew the location[N]of Mount Kehres on [NAM:0]'s[N]map![END]`

dialogstring_07D892! `[TPL:4][TPL:B]Elazquez: It's said that[N]the tears of the gods in[N]the Tearpot can reflect[N]the true form of things.[END]`

dialogstring_07E0E5! `[TPL:1][TPL:9]Ann: Thank you. I think I[N]still want to eat one.[END]`

dialogstring_07E10A! `[TPL:1][BOR:D][TPL:B]Ann: Why do you keep going[N]back and forth to the[N]market like this, bringing[N]apples for me as many[FIN][N]times as I ask…?[FIN]Is it for that [NAM:1][N]girl…? Or…?[FIN]Well, that's alright. As[N]thanks, I'll give you this[N]jewel.[FIN][CLD][SFX:10][TPL:8][NAM:0] got a Red Jewel![END]`

dialogstring_07E19D! `[TPL:1][TPL:9]Ann: Take good care of[N][NAM:1], alright…?[END]`

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'eu93_found'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07E531! `[DEF]You found it here. I[N]understand your wishes.[N]I'll give you the power[N]at once.[END]`

dialogstring_07E566! `[DEF]Well, go.[END]`

-------------------------------------

-------------------------------------
?INCLUDE 'eu95_neils_father'

?INCLUDE 'eu95_neil'
-------------------------------------
dialogstring_07E3F4! `[TPL:6][TPL:8][DLY:2]Neil: …[FIN][TPL:B]Even though I understood[N]how my parents had[N]welcomed me after I had[N]been separated from my[N]family…[FIN][NAM:0]… It might be[N]inconveniencing you, but[N]could you leave me alone[N]for a while…?[FIN][TPL:0][TPL:B][DLY:1]Neil hung his head as he[N]spoke… It was the first[N]time I had ever seen Neil[N]like this…[END]`

;Guest room

dialogstring_07DC37! `[TPL:0][TPL:A]However, the next morning.[N]Unfortunate news was[N]waiting for us…[END]`

dialogstring_07DC63! `[TPL:6][TPL:A]Neil: Good morning. I[N]guess I've caused everyone[N]to worry…[FIN][TPL:12]I've been thinking about[N]it all night, but in the[N]end I feel like this[N]company can't continue[N]unless I inherit it.[FIN][CLD][TPL:6][TPL:9]I want to do something to[N]stop the slave trade;[FIN][TPL:12]I was thinking that the[N]company that first[N]established that slave[N]trade should work towards[N]abolishing it…[FIN][CLD][TPL:6][TPL:A]I guess there's no way[N]around exchanging human[N]misery for money.[FIN][TPL:1][TPL:B][NAM:1]: So, that must mean[N]Neil's going to become the[N]president of the company?[N]Cooooool!![FIN][TPL:6][TPL:B]Neil: Hehe. I'm feeling[N]kind of embarrassed for[N]some reason.[END]`

dialogstring_07DD70! `[TPL:6][TPL:A][DLY:2]Neil: Ah, and from that,[N][NAM:1]. There's a person[N]who came to visit you.[FIN]You've talked before about[N]your old sweetheart.[FIN][CLD][TPL:1][TPL:8][DLY:0][NAM:1]: Huh…!?[END]`

dialogstring_07DDBF! `[TPL:6][TPL:8]Neil: Hey, come in…![END]`

dialogstring_07DDD2! `[TPL:1][TPL:8][NAM:1]: [NAM:7]…![FIN][CLD][BOR:3][TPL:8]Squee squee…![FIN][TPL:1][TPL:8]How?! Was she okay?![FIN][TPL:6][TPL:A]Neil: Hahaha. It seems[N]like she was chasing after[N]you all the way.[FIN][NAM:2] discovered her in[N]the Floating City and sent[N]her for us.[FIN]You could call it[N]Reuleck's delivery[N]service.[FIN][TPL:12]Even though I'm no longer[N]one of your travel[N]companions, aren't you[N]gaining even more powerful[N]allies?[END]`

dialogstring_08830F! `[TPL:0][TPL:E][DLY:2][NAM:0]: Mrrrm… [NAM:7]…?[N]Let me sleep a little[N]more…[FIN][TPL:1][TPL:E][DLY:1][NAM:1]: Ugh… Wait a second,[N][NAM:0]… Don't touch me in[N]weird places…[FIN][CLD][PAU:3C][TPL:1][TPL:D][DLY:0][NAM:1]: Huh…! Who…?[N]Who are you…?![END]`

dialogstring_08839D! `[TPL:0][TPL:A][SFX:0]It seemed like they could[N]have been a cannibal[N]tribe…[FIN][TPL:1][TPL:A][NAM:1]: Look. Those[N]children. They're going[N]to eat usss…![END]`
